reviews.text: Highlight of our trip! We hiked Elephant Mountain 2 days prior, and this was so much better! Still a lot of stairs, but less popular and surrounded by gorgeous greenery. 10/10 recommend!

A Thread of Sky (一線天) is a striking natural feature located along the Xiangshan Trail, offering a unique and picturesque stop for hikers. This narrow rock formation creates a dramatic “slice” of sky between towering cliffs, making it a fascinating and photogenic spot that feels almost otherworldly.

Reaching A Thread of Sky involves a bit of climbing, but the trail leading there is manageable and well-marked. As you approach, the light filtering through the rocky crevice creates a stunning effect, especially during early morning or late afternoon. It’s a great place to pause, take in the beauty of nature, and capture some memorable photos.
Nice hiking trail, not crowded, well paved.
Natural formation of two rocks paving a way. worth the detour from the peak climb for a quick photo
This tiny walk through in between two giant stones is part of the lower route of Xiang Shan trail.

reviews.text:
When I was there, I had the thought of entering the wrong place. Their lobby is decorated too nice, and felt like not a hostel 😂
The staff were friendly and helpful, my check in was smooth. The room was clean and tidy, well maintained as well. On The roof level you will have a dining area, cooking space, share fridge, washing room, swimming pool and rooftop relaxing area. Overall my staying experience was good, price was good as affordable, I will definitely recommend this to anyone who wants to visit TaiNan.

Not very welcoming, as on arrival you are ordered to sign a form stating that you agree to multiple large fines for violating their many rules.

While the pods have clearly been well thought out, and are reasonably comfy, there are some obvious design flaws and serious management issues.

Lazy worker mentality is clearly represented in the poor cleanliness of the bathroom space especially, which is also very poorly designed and implemented. There is nowhere dry to get dressed.
The cube showers are mouldy and dirty. The men's room is exposed to full view from the hall when the main door opens, so you cannot use the urinals without the people in the hall seeing.

You are asked to change to slippers on the floors, but not given any clean ones...these are reused who knows how many times, and I had to wash mine...but that doesn't prevent others taking them from the shoe cubby.

It is also not a social hostel in the kitchen area, which is the only possible space, and most guests treat the tightly enclosed dorm as their private hotel... Talking loudly to their travel companions, and being generally noisy and  disrespectful in a sleeping space, at sleeping times, especially bad in the mornings.
The door has no soft close mechanism, so literally all night, and through the morning, the door is slamming very loudly, because stupid guests can't work out how to use the handle to close the door gently.

I did partially book this place for the rooftop pool, but I guess they only fill it sometimes. It was empty when I was there despite being warm enough.

Wifi seems quite erratic, and it seems the only way to get a somewhat "reliable" connection is to log into multiple wifi and set your device to auto connect to strongest signal.

For all the money spent on setting this place up, it's a shame it's so poorly run.

Front door of hotel are no locked. No 24 hr reception. I woke up at 6am and saw a men sleeping with three big luggages in the rooftop lounge kitchen. The reception only comes at 7am,. when I went down to reception, she didn’t even apologise about it and said matter of factly that it is a regular guest and he always comes at night to sleep. The hotel had strict policies to checkout at 11am else we need to be charge extra and yet they allow such things. so everyone now can just come in and sleep at the rooftop garden and lounge be used - so scary . yet they tell use to leave our bicycles and bags at reception in open area. First time I see a hotel with so little lacking of guest security and property. please go and get your front door fixed! I heard it has not been fixed for a long time to save cost!!!

I've stayed in a lot of hostels and this is one of the best. Don't expect many English speakers if that's your bag but the facilities are top-notch and the location is good too. The provided slippers are a bit small if you have big feet but that's really splitting hairs. It is very slightly on the expensive end for a hostel but the price is still pretty reasonable given the facilities and the other stuff you get (breakfast coupons, etc). Has laundry for NTD 50 a pop.

The aircon and hot water didn't work in my room. When I mentioned this to the staff I was moved to another room on a different floor (floor four to floor five) but the aircon there also didn't work and it was a completely different room type , which I assumed was due to my room type being fully booked.

I went down to reception again , advised I was still not happy so was moved to another room ( same floor) and same type as the first room (so I'm unsure why I wasn't given this room to begin with.

However the aircon still did not seem to be working.

Eventually the staff advised that their aircon was not working (for all floors except floor 3)

And when I asked why I wasn't informed in advance I was told it only broke this morning (no idea if this is true or not)

They did say that after a period of time the room would cool down. After leaving for 5 hours to get dinner and drinks the room was still 25c.

Fortunately I was provided a refund (after much back and forth) but was told I must check out the next morning. So queue me finding a new hotel last minute due to their negligence.

Even after a full refund I would never stay here again as I don't feel you can't trust management's word.

Aside from the fact that the hot water and aircon did not work in any of the three rooms I was given , there was also an overwhelming smell of mould throughout every floor except the lobby and mouldy stained carpet in the halls.

The lobby is very nice but perhaps they should have spent less money on their koi pond and more on their core amenities needed for a good night's sleep.

reviews.text: I would like to put more stars if I could. This hostel is one of the best managed hostel I have every stayed in my life. The staff is incredibly friendly and welcoming. The common room at the entrance is very convenient for meeting other travellers, at the same time it is incredibly convenient for getting some work done on a laptop. The hostel is incredibly clean, I had the impression there is always staff cleaning something. I initially booked for a few days but extended my stay because it was very nice. Also there is very good local ginger beef soup down the street at the roundabout.

I ended up staying here for multiple weeks, and it was a fantastic stay! There are busy periods and quiet periods, but the environment was great throughout, and a mix of local and foreign visitors. The owners/workers are lovely, very friendly and helpful, and always offered little plates/bowls of (delicious) prepared fruit! There are plugs by the beds and in the ground floor common area, Wi-Fi was good and consistent, and many other things about the place were very positive. I would highly recommend this hostel.

Very lovely staff, who will run an extra mile to make you feel welcome, including complimentary yoghurt and fruits. The place is very clean and comfortable, privacy is great as well. It was lovely exploring Tainan from this place. Very friendly price as well. Would definitly come again :)

I had a really rough first night here due to the worst snoring person, that has no right to be staying in dorms. Nobody got sleep that night because of him.
The following day I begged to move to another room because of this, and the manager was quite helpful, which I am hugely grateful for.
The manager is friendly, and gives free fruit and dumplings or cakes daily to guests.
The common room is quite clean and functional.
The first room I was in was kind-of tight and not super comfortable, but the second room was a bit more open.

The pods could be cleaned a little better as there was a used tissue in mine, and the walls were kinda gross in both rooms I occupied, though the bedding is clean and comfortable.

Downside, I tried to do laundry... The sign says 10ntd per load for any load, which I found out to be untrue. After my load had stopped halfway through the rinse cycle, I finished washing my clothes in the sink because I thought the machine was faulty until the girl staff said it's 10 per 16 mins... So you might need 20 or 30ntd for a load.
The clothes drying area was outdoors so despite drying for two nights, my clothes were still wet when I left.

Rooms were good, location was great but the service was amazing.
The owner is on it, he's always working on something to make people feel welcome 11/10
Genuinely surprised it is only a 4.6
Great common room to get work done!

Spacious room with wide windows. There are no taller buildings in the view so you can get a clear view of the sky!

Room and toilet is clean. Plenty of plugs to use.

Service is great. We tried room service and the portion of the food is quite big.

It’s connected to Far Eastern mall which is convenient.

That did not distract from a plentiful breakfast. Cleaning of the tables could use a lot more training as I saw the staff simply pushing food leftovers into the carpeted floor.

It is a nice hotel. It has nice service. Only the elevator system was not enjoyable for me. It often takes a long time until one of the elevators arrive on ground level or on room level, also during off-peak times. Often the number of people waiting is getting large. It is recommended to leave the room five minutes earlier if you have appointments. Otherwise I like the hotel. The building is also quite photogenic from several perspectives as my attached photos might show.

We recently stayed in an executive floor suite at Shangri-La Far Eastern, Tainan for three nights and were thoroughly impressed with the service. The staff’s attentiveness and proactive approach, especially Shiuan and Lana’s meticulous care in the Lounge, made our stay a truly memorable one. Compared to other hotels we’ve stayed at in Taiwan, this experience not only met but exceeded our expectations. The level of service and attention to detail truly set Shangri-La Far Eastern, Tainan apart, delivering an impressive service that makes it a stay worth recommending.

Carpet and closet was a bit smelly.

reviews.text:
The rooms in this still relatively new hotel are clean and minimalistic with wooden flooring. The service was good, and the staff was attentive.
I did not like the breakfast at all. Choices are limited, and the omelet I ordered had almost cold ingredients despite the outside temperature.
For breakfast, I chose a daily 20 min walk to the near by Shangri-la, where the breakfast choices are plentiful, though the rooms are understood to be stuffy and old.

Grand Banyan is a fairly new hotel with minimalistic vibes. The gym is on the smaller end but everything feels clean. They also offer free wash/dry, but you’ll have to pay 20NT for pods if you don’t have detergent.

They also don’t provide toiletries in accordance with the upcoming restrictions - but they do provide standard shampoo and body gel only.

I thought it was fine that the toilet was separate from the main bathroom, but found it weird there was no soap readily available. That was a bit off-putting.

Excellent hotel staff who are very helpful. Conceige was nice to help reserve restaurant and make recommendation. Reception is really professional too. room is spacious and comfy, and conveniently located ( about 20 minutes walk to many sightseeing) . Highly recommended.
Located near the Tainan Train Station, it is easily accessible.  The room is quiet, clean and spacious.  The staff are friendly and helpful.  Everything is great and I like this hotel so much.

reviews.text:
A very well designed/decorated hotel lacking the simple things. Love the design, the addition of neuvo items to add to the ambience however the rooms are not for families. If you have kids and value any privacy at all in the bathroom then this isn’t the hotel for you…or if you want to sit down on an actual chair in your hotel room as there aren’t any other than a half full bean bag chair.

The breakfast offered although tasty is a lunch dinner menu for breakfast so except to eat a burger at 8am not toast or anything to do with breakfast at all.

The good though is really good. It is a beautiful hotel and if I was 20 years younger it would have been cool to stay here. With 2 kids in town and luggage for a family it was however not fun as there just isn’t any room to open luggage in the room and actually walk around.

The staff. They are by far some of the best hotel staff that I have seen. Attention to detail, helpful and super friendly and if their boss reads this they all deserve a raise.

Cons: The sound insulation in the rooms is terrible. You can hear everything your neighbors are doing including flushing toilets (you can even hear water running down the wall pipes). The cleaning staff is also quite loud and the carts they use to stack the glassware make a lot of noise in the hallways.

The breakfast is fine, but overpriced if you buy it separate from the room. There are far better and cheaper options around the area.

The bathroom is a little weird. The toilet room is semi transparent and you can still see someone moving around in there and certainly hear everything.

Pros:
Good, centrally located spot with lots of interesting attractions and food options nearby.

The building itself is very nice looking and the shared space on the third floor is nice.

The rooms were also very clean.

Trendy hotel in a very convenient location. The room is spacious, clean and adequately fitted with conveniences although the bathroom smells a bit of drainage. I love the idea of having a vinyl machine in the room.

The entire third floor is communal with a lot of resting areas and an open kitchen, where guests are encouraged to make the own meals and coffee.

If you don’t feel like cooking, there’s plenty of options around the hotel with markets, restaurants and coffee shops.

I recently stayed at this hotel and found it to be more of a stylish hostel than a traditional hotel. While it has some unique design elements, such as exposed brick walls, it may not meet the expectations of those looking for a full-service hotel experience.

The rooms are on the smaller side, and while the service is decent, it isn’t at the level of a five-star hotel. There are some thoughtful touches, like a well-equipped common area and good location near eateries, but certain aspects—such as the lack of in-room heating—may be a drawback, especially in colder weather.

Overall, it’s a reasonable choice for those who enjoy boutique-style accommodations, but for the same price, I would personally opt for a five-star hotel with more amenities and a proper buffet breakfast.

Very good hotel room, we stayed for three nights and had zero complaints. The staff was very helpful and there were always at least three people working in the front. There was a coffee shop in the lobby, too. The 3rd floor space is a nice bonus, with a full kitchen for free use. I felt that the location was good too, central to the city but nothing right outside that kept me awake. I would definitely stay here again given the chance!

reviews.text:
Booking with Agoda, Room 402, Meisheng Building 2
At first I went to the shared area to put my luggage and thought the B&B was cheap and beautiful.
Makes me look forward to my room
We checked into the room at about three o'clock and found that the room had a strange smell, which was very similar to the smell of carrot farts. I thought it was just the strange smell from the previous accommodation that had not spread. Although there was an essential oil sprayer in the room, there was no smell, so we opened the window and turned on the air conditioning and dehumidifier. Then we went out to run our schedule. When we came back at eight o'clock, the smell was still strong. Considering that it was not I wanted to fall asleep with this smell, so I called the B&B to tell them about the problem, hoping they could help. Unexpectedly, the B&B didn't apologize for the bad smell in their room at the first time. They actually blamed us for not informing us at the first time. Hello, how do I know whether your carrot fart smell is temporary or permanent? I didn't know the flavor would last so long, okay? Why do you have the nerve to blame us? Are you saying that no one else responded but us? ! If you don't believe it, why don't you confirm it yourself? Is this your attitude towards dealing with problems? It's not about solving the problem, it's about shirking responsibility! During the phone call, he was talking to himself and had no intention of listening to us. Later, he was told to ask the boss, but the second call came back and asked us to refund the fee to Agoda and find another hotel to check in. What time is it? Is it possible for me to find a room outside? Force me to accept it? Your room smells like carrot fart. I'm not angry, I just feel disgusted. But your attitude is really shocking! My family lives upstairs on the fifth floor and there is no carrot fart smell. I can only say that I am really unlucky. In fact, there is a lot of dust in the corners of the house, the sofa looks disgusting, and the curtains also have disgusting stains. I thought I would just get used to the fart smell. No, it really smells bad and uncomfortable when I sleep.🤮🤮🤮

I have always liked this room type
It’s really beautiful to take pictures
But I was so disappointed when I checked in
The room smelled musty and the mattress was dented
The bed is rusty and unclean...it may cause allergies
The point is that the air conditioner is not cold at all
It can only be controlled at 24 degrees...otherwise it will leak (the room is marked)
The bathroom is beautifully landscaped and perfect for taking photos
Plants are real and not fake
So a lot of spider webs and centipedes
I’m really a little scared (why don’t real plants have windows? What should I do if there are insects)

For the first time in my life, I booked a hotel room and went straight home without spending the night.
It just so happened that there was nothing special the next day.
So I drove north.

在booking .com訂房，抵達後需要聯繫小幫手，會告知正門跟房間密碼，完全自行入住，費用要轉帳會先請訪客取消booking 的訂房，說是因為booking 會跟訂房的消費者收取額外的費用，其實應該是跟商家收取，我覺得取消也沒關係，有些商家會因為消費者協助，額外減免，互利商家跟消費者，但是靡生沒有，感受會比較不好。

床墊稍稍有點凹陷，但是整體佈置真的蠻漂亮，沒有給瓶裝水，是玻璃罐裝飲用水，可以上樓自取咖啡、茶、還有小餅乾，因為浴室有很多植栽，真的是很美也浪漫，有持續開除濕器，還有香氛，也提供藍牙喇叭，所以情境很好，難免石頭植栽發霉，泡澡看見蟑螂，如果不細看，真的是蠻有風情的民宿。
單人住宿平日1980其實不算便宜，偶爾一次體驗還可以。

The room type we stayed in this time was room 401 in the second building.

The room price is really cheap, 1580 on weekdays. It has a bathtub and an independent balcony.

And the overall space makes people feel very comfortable. I will definitely stay here again if I have the opportunity to come to Tainan in the future. The staff at the front desk introduced me very carefully. The rooms and public spaces are spotless. The bathroom has sufficient water and does not get hot or cold. There is also a small table in the room for use, which is very convenient! Shower gel, shampoo, and toothbrush are all very useful. I think they were carefully selected.

入住當天因行程變動的關係提前去放行李，大約12點就有管家接電話告知如何進民宿，這點我個人覺得很窩心跟加分

check in時也細心告知當天住宿的相關事宜，不論是客廳或房間所呈現的氛圍及質感都十分到位，個人覺得比入住前看的照片都還要來的寬敞許多

reviews.text: Overall a really pleasant experience. Paul was very knowledgable, friendly and helpful. 10 out of 10! I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend to anyone who travels to Tainan!

Our stay here wasn’t great, it was outstanding! The beds were so comfortable that we got our best sleep in the last few weeks. Location is conveniently close to many attractions, restaurants, and the train station; but it was still peaceful and quiet in our room.

What made this stay so memorable was the owner, Paul (English name). He showed us around Tainan, brought us fruit and tasty Taiwanese snacks, and helped us figure out where to go during our stay. Especially if this is your first time visiting Tainan, this is the best place to stay.

Very clean room, great location. I would stay there again! :) The wifi also very fast and perfect for working. Furthermore, the hotel is located well.

The only downside is, that they do not accept credit card payment, which is inconvenient for foreign travelers and also that they do not provide towels, unless you ask for them.

The most friendly owner we have ever seen, patiently introduce useful information about Tainan in English, even preparing some fruit for my girlfriend after finishing the visiting.

Also the friendly price, nice location etc. too many pros to book this hostel for travelers to Tainan.

在訂房平台找到這間寶藏住宿地點，可惜平台評論功能貌似故障無法寫，但這間住的非常滿意，沒寫實在對不起自己TT，於是來Ｇｏｏｇｌｅ地圖這邊寫評論🙌

老闆人非常好！入住時提供紅茶及水果享用🤤並且告訴我們附近景點及路線建議，讓我對台南旅遊有個方向✨

因為當天有空房，所以老闆幫我們免費升等，同時也主動告知原本房間較安靜，升等後的房間因靠近馬路，會有些車流聲，來讓我們評估是否要換房間，剛好我們都非淺眠的人，所以果斷選升等房，一整晚睡得很好，床睡起來也非常舒適，隔天賴床到退房前XDD

住宿價格非常便宜，地點也很方便，未來有機會到台南旅行，有需要一定會再回來這間住🌟

reviews.text: Great place to stay in a small back alley in Central Tainan. Can highly recommend to stay here if you want to experience in an old house in Tainan. Beautifully assembled with naturally cooling stone/terrazzo floor, old iron work around the windows, a small balcony and large shared area on the ground floor. There are only three rooms on the building.

The hotel is very well decorated, has a very pleasant atmosphere, and great care is evident in the small details. It looks even nicer in person than in the photos. Everything is very clean and well-maintained. The hosts are very kind, speak several languages, and took the time to give us extra information about the city. The hotel has the perfect location for exploring Tainan, which is important in a city where public transportation is not very good.

Stayed for 2 nights with 2 occupancy.  Although the stairway was a little big hard for my mother to climb up/down.   But the room is spacious. I’ve always loved the vintage decorations and old Tainan house style. Can’t ask for more.

Neat clean guesthouse transformed from the Taiwanese ancient style house within the modern design touch in detail. The hospitality from the multilingual host’s knowledge about the city reveals the passion. Staying on a Saturday tranquil night but awake by the scooter engine starting noise saying good night and hummingbird good morning. Nevertheless, at 9:30 am, the air flights passing by could be the pattern of the city center daily life of a snail lane and it’s charm too. A Must in Tainan.

There are 2 single rooms with shared bathroom and a rooftop suite. We stayed in the suite. This place was cozy and nice.The owners were friendly. But it did not have everything. There was no soap by the sink( The shared bathroom has it). The shampoo and conditioner were only half full at most. In addition, the chair was broken so the nail revealed. There was a seat cousin on the top of chair so it was not easy to find. I am disappointed about the hazard because it almost hurt my kid.

👉Stay in a 2F quadruple room during the winter vacation (not during the Spring Festival)
✅Because it was a temporary decision, I booked a room through Booking near noon that day. The butler's reply was immediate and the information was very detailed. He also informed me in advance that there was no elevator and the old house was located on the side of the road and the sound insulation was not so good. Any relevant points that needed attention or would be discussed were informed in advance. 👍
🟩Self check-in is very convenient, so you don’t have to worry about missing your check-in due to your itinerary.
🟩The public space is clean and comfortable, and tea bags, coffee and biscuits are provided. The room is also very clean and large, and the bed is good to sleep on.
🟩The location is good, there are many famous stores nearby and you can reach it within a short walk.
🟨There are parking spaces, but there are not many. If it is a holiday peak, there is no guarantee that there will be parking. You have to confirm with the steward.
🟨There is no elevator...but the stairs in the old house are very narrow. If your luggage is too large, be careful as it will be very difficult to move.
🟨The sound insulation is really not good, and there are quite a lot of cars on the roadside. If you are really a light sleeper, please think twice.
🟨There is no exhaust in the room-type toilet when we go to it, and it does not have quick-drying tiles. It will be very humid after taking a shower, but it is actually very clean and there is no damp or musty smell.
🟩It’s good to sort out the experience, but many hardware problems are difficult, and it may be difficult to get better. I will choose to visit again if I have the opportunity.

reviews.text:
From the moment we arrived at this unassuming two-star hotel, I knew it would be a stay to remember. While my wife initially mistook it for a 12-story rice restaurant (a quirky mix-up we still laugh about), it quickly became clear that this place had a lot more to offer than expected.

The hotel is ideally located just a stone's throw from the main station, making it incredibly convenient for exploring the city. Whether you're hopping on a train or catching a bus - which conveniently never run to time, you're well-connected. I was pleasantly surprised to see life buoys in every bus – an amusing yet thoughtful touch that added to the charm of our stay. I later learned no one in the city has drowned on a bus, an exceptional safety record.

The reception staff went above and beyond, with their friendly demeanor and eagerness to help, which made us feel at home right away. Their hospitality truly made a difference during our visit.

As a bonus, I indulged in my favorite treat—Häagen-Dazs ice cream. It was the perfect end to a perfect stay. All in all, while this hotel may not be the most luxurious, it offers great value, exceptional location, and a personal touch that left us with fond memories.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a cozy, well-located stay with a bit of character.

Can't beat the location right across from the train station, and where virtually every bus line in the city meets. Front staff is amazing and beyond helpful. Rooms vary in size, and some are quite spacious. Like many local hotels in Taiwan the beds are very firm, and the shower lacks a door so tends to leak on the floor (but lots of high pressure and hot water which isn't always true at many Taiwan local hotels).

Comfortable for a 3-star hotel. Basic room amenities, room is clean and spacious, bed is big but a little too firm for my little.

Big thanks to concierge staff, especially Team Leader Leticia for her great and polite customer service! She is always readily available to answer my queries or offer assistance. She made my experience here at a very pleasant one! ⭐️⭐️⭐️
It is in a very good location, but the room itself is not that new or clean. Most of the 5 stars we see here (I believe) were given due to the free cake/ice-cream.

Spacious the room was. And the reception was great and fast (except for the younger of the reception team, whom couldn’t understand simple requests and started grumbling when my request changed due to her inefficient sharing of instructions). Hoping for a good night’s stay.

reviews.text: I had a fantastic stay here! I was there for two nights. Really awesome rooms, fantastic service from the concierge every time I went down there, and super cool breakfast setup. I tried the fried rice cake option and the egg salad sandwich, since everyone seemed to get that, and both were delicious. I LOVED the tea at breakfast also. It was the perfect amount of sweetness. The location was wonderful as well. Couldn't recommend more.

Excellent! Bathroom and bedroom had everything we needed, including a blow dryer and extra mirror. Very comfortable bed and delicious breakfast options with great service. My only TINY critique is that the tea they serve with breakfast is a British company Twinings. I could not believe in a country known for its tea, they do not have Taiwanese tea. Every other hotel I've stayed in for 2 weeks has had Taiwanese tea. This was only a minor grievance, but I have loved the tea in Taiwan, so I was disappointed they had the very average Twinings as their breakfast tea. Otherwise, everything was amazing.

I booked the Tatami style room and it was gorgeous and Huge. There were mattresses if needed, and though I took a quick Nap on just the Tatami mat just fine, I ended up using the mattress.
It was pretty clean, and very modern too.
The room didnt get any sun so was dark and cold, but besides this, everything else was great.
The breakfast included was fantastic, they had 4 varieties to choose from, I tried 3 of them and they were all great.

I would recommend this place for sure.

Quiet and nice place in the evenings. Service is absolutely astounding, counter was very gracious in providing directions, breakfast staff remembered my preferences each day (i asked for butter on the first day, and got a packet of butter without asking on the second!!)

Retro 90s Japanese design, but doesn’t look dated in the slightest. Brutalist-style architecture with a most careful attention to detail.

Soundproofing is not bad but could be better.

I absolutely and wholeheartedly recommend this place. Thank you, Retro Tai-Pan, for making the trip much better.

谢谢你们！ 服务超级好，床很舒服，好像饭来张口，衣来伸手！

We visited Tainan for the first time and decided to book at Tai-Pan Hotel. The location from Tainan train station was around 15 minutes bus ride and 5 minutes walk. The check-in process was smooth and easy. The receptionist also offered breakfast menu for the following day. The room was uniquely retro and cool. It's clean and tidy too. However, the bathroom had a smell but relatively mild. The location was also near to many POIs and easily reachable by foot. We would definitely stay here again for our next trip!

reviews.text:
We have been like a regular customer and have stayed at this hotel a lot of times with my family already in the past this place was very very good.
The food,the service,the cleanliness,but…it fell off hard. Recently when I visited this hotel I found out that the breakfast standards dropped so much,it was still edible but…it wasn’t as good u know? I’m also about to say something that might make you guys freak out and not want to stay here, there was a glass shard on the floor. It wasn’t big but I stepped on it and my leg hurt,maybe the staff didn’t vacuum the floor thoroughly but I’m just saying that a child might get hurt, so…and room even didn’t provide toilet paper roll. Anyways ,the whole room is a square bro,other hotel are like rectangle and shit but this room is a square which make it so claustrophobic! Anyway on to the good part, The hair dryer was so nice! It wasn’t very hot like your scalp was burning when you used it. And as you might know,there are earthquakes and so electricity might be cut off and they provided a literal torchlight!
First time! Like they all say safety first am I right? Another thing is that the lobby has a little book to write or draw some stuff to show that you have visited and stayed in that hotel which is so cute. Overall ,this place is quite ok.
An amazing hotel experience. Rooms are on the smaller side but very well appointed and spotlessly clean. The service was stellar. The breakfast buffet was very good value.

Pleasant stay.  Room was spacious and room layout is practical.  Seperate shower to toilet and wash basin also seperate.  Makes sharing a room easy.  Water pressure in shower was good.  Hotel was modern and clean.

Room had free snacks and also free bottled water which can get replenished.  Had mini fridge and hairdryer.  Also provided slippers.

Free breakfast was nice.  Not a lot of variety (or changes) however sufficient for a short stay.

Only one lift so can be slow especially since hotel had 10 levels.

Room had aircond which was refreshing in the heat but can be a bit cold at night.  Mattress was firm and light switches were plenty however can be a bit confusing which controlled which.

Tainan station is walkable however beware that if you have luggage, it’s a bit of a pain as the pathways were not designed for pedestrians.  So you are practically sharing the road with cars which can be a bit overwhelming.  We ended up taking a taxi to hotel which costs NTD85, felt much safer that way.

Two convenience stores within walking distance.

Would recommend

A very cozy hotel located in an excellent location. The breakfast they provided was excellent and very worth it. Our rooms were super clean and the shower was spacious. We also especially liked the provided shampoo and body wash, they had a really nice scent.

The staff went above and beyond to accommodate us during typhoon Gaemi. We were in Hualien the day before, and because of the typhoon we were unable to commute to the hotel on that day. The hotel staff allowed us to change our dates of stay last minute free of charge and we are extremely thankful for that.

Check in and out usually take awhile when there are a lot of guests at the same time, recep staffs able to manage and handle it fast . They able to answer your enquiries mannerly. Staffs went for extra miles to check on my enquiry of housekeeping and call for cab when I was anxious of running late to train station. Thankful for the recep ladies!!

Check-in and check-out can take some time when there’s a crowd, but the reception staff manage it efficiently. They also respond to inquiries politely. I’m especially grateful to the reception team for going the extra mile to check on my housekeeping request and arrange a cab when I was worried about being late for the train. Big thanks to the reception ladies!

The overall environment could use some improvement, especially in cleanliness, as I noticed dust near the window. I stayed in a Superior Room with a window on a high floor, near the lift. The sound insulation was average, but I think that’s more due to guests' behavior. I did enjoy the high floor and the nice view, though I heard some sounds near the curtain at night, possibly birds outside.

Breakfast was decent, and the location is great—close to a bus stop, retail stores, including food and sportswear shops, and bubble tea spots!

The noise insulation is also rather inadequate. Other than that, the bed was comfy, toilet working, shower is hot and amenities adequate.

Service - The staff goes out of their way to please and is eager to greet and provide assistance. Breakfast is good and I'm grateful for the afternoon tea service (free beverages, ice cream and munchies).

Location - approximately 1km walk from the train station which is manageable. It's also walking distance to several famous spots in Tainan including Shennong Street, Yongle Market, Hayashi Departmental Store and many fantastic eateries around.
They offer free afternoon tea and the bed is comfy. Pillows are ergonomic!! Sometimes prices will drop down. Given the shuttle from the railway station operates twice a day, that's a big bargain.

We had a good stay, friendly, comfy, clean and lovely breakfast.
A bit out dated design but still functioning well.

reviews.text: I am obsessed with Mazehut! I wish every hostel was exactly like this. The little personal cubbies were so comfortable, fully private and had everything you need — mirror, hangers, fold down desk, light, electrical plug, fan, cozy blankets and pillow, lock/key, storage unit! WiFi was super strong too! Bathrooms were bright, spacious, clean and smelled amazing. There are a couple communal areas to chill, work,  or eat. Free water is accessible too, including tea. You also have access to a fridge. The staff is super friendly and helpful the whole time. I’m a solo female traveler who felt safe the whole time. Location is SUPERB! Walking distance to everything. Absolutely zero complaints. 100/10 ¨̮
This was a very safe, clean, quiet place.  It's well organized and well kept.  It's so quiet you'd feel guilty making any noise.  It has nice, modern decor.

One of the grooviest hostels I've stayed in while backpacking. Steel your expectations and make sure to check the listing and photos before booking. This is a somewhat off-kilter accommodation which is made fantastically kitsch by the vibe that is set by the owner Jerry.

The property is renovated by a few connecting buildings in a very groovy little block known for its ancient charm, brought back to life by the modern art culture of Tainan. What would otherwise be a convoluted and weird layout is all validated by the name of the hostel - It's called Jerry's Mazehut for a reason. He has preserved the culture of these old buildings - you are staying in a piece of history.

You enter through one building, head out into a patio, up a flight of stairs across to the next building and there is the dorm. Keep going further, down another set of stairs, and you get to the bathroom. There is a little dining lounge tucked away, a few private rooms hidden in unseeming parts of the building, and on top of that, Jerry runs an incredible little teahouse in it during the day.

The pods are like mini-cabins with lockable doors, an internal fan for airflow, and at least four well-sized vents to control ventilation. Your stuff is safe in the pod when you go out since you can lock it, but you're also provided with an additional underbed storage locker as well. The pods layout are very well thought out; the bottom is accessed from the side, the top is accessed from the front, so two bunkmates never get in the way of each other.

Despite the odd layout, Jerry has provided a wealth of resources to help you so there is no question. Upon booking, he will make his contact available so that he can send you links, YouTube videos, and resources on how to navigate and use the hostel and the area around it. Anything else can be addressed by simply asking him if he's in the teahouse, or messaging him.

Free self-serve washing machine is on site as well which is incredible, though there is no dryer. But Jerry provides a large amount of coat hangers and pegs so it's no issue, especially since it's free.

The social vibe is mature and relaxed, but I found it easy to socialise as the little room outside the dorms is very cosy.

Through and through, it's a well-priced hostel at the end of the day, and you get a lot here for what you pay for, so any shortcomings that this place has are more than dwarfed by the quality it offers.

Unique house, clean and everything worked well.
I'm not sure how I like the box/capsule arrangement. The airflow was not great - there is a fan you can turn on but it blows right down on the side of your head, and it's quite noisy so I didn't want to use it when people were sleeping (which obviously was when I was there). Lockers for luggage required 2 keys and was all down on the floor which is not optimal.

Overall a nice hostel with a unique touch, fair price, and a good location!

The Good: Nice capsules/pods, nice showers, quiet, clean, great staff, 150m from bus lines to the train station, nicely renovated building in a historic area where people take a lot of Insta's.

The Bad: It's small (13 beds) so no real hostel vibe, beds and baths are on different floors, no self-catering (just a fridge, microwave and cups), only one small indoor table for work or study, 2 of the 3 baths have a urinal in your face when you sit on the toilet, they don't accept credit cards but accept PayPal.

TIP #1: Check the hostel's website before booking -- the price was much lower than other sites.

TIP #2: If you use the bath near the front entrance at night, take your key or you may be locked out of the hostel.

The kids took one look and asked 'Oooh, is this a 5-star hotel?'. It is spacious and the beds are comfortable and it is very clean with a luxury hotel feel. We usually stay budget.

Not sure what the camping theme is about in the rooms. There is a balcony area. So good to get some fresh air. We need to be in the Chimei Museum area tomorrow and the proximity to this hotel is why we chose it. Free biscuits and coffee area in the lobby.

The room also has a big patio where you can sit and relax.  Free coffee machines and snacks.  Laundry room is very useful for travelers.  There’s also a big pool.  Overall, a comfortable and laid back hotel.

Breakfast is buffet only.  Would recommend to let guests also order a la carte.

To top off our  terrible experience, we received an email from staff on our last night reminding us that check-out time is 11am and that any late check out would be chargeable. In my everyday travel going for my business meetings, the concierge always book me a taxi and tell the driver where I am going. As I go, they bow their  heads as a sign of respect and farewell. Its the same when you arrive.

For this, I have a wonderful experience with this Hotel

reviews.text:
Nice hotel right in the middle of a lot of sights in Tainan.

Positive:
+ Great location.
+ Free snacks from 7:00 - 10:00 am (coffee, tea, cornflakes, oats, milk, croissants and toast).
+ Super friendly receptionist.
+ Clean, comfortable, good WiFi.

This is a good place to stay in Tainan.

The room is clean and comfortable, there is a mini fridge inside. It is small and the bathroom is small, so it might feel a little cramp. The sound proof is ridiculously good, there was a typhoon when we went, and we barely hear anything at all.

The service is very good, very nice and helpful and friendly. Their English is not very strong but they did try to help us as much as they could.

The location is very good, close to many good restaurants. It is also close to the main street, we can walk to Confucious temple, shennong street, and many other place. We barely need to take a bus the whole trip. There is also a famous boba shop right across the street too.

There is no breakfast, but they have free snack in the morning (buns, bread, cereal, etc.) and coffee, enough before heading out.

They have a big space in the lobby with table where we can eat food too.

Overall, great place great value, totally recommended.

Clean but very compact room. Breakfast is very basic. Didn't even eat it as it looked too plain.

Bed is a bit firm.

Staff are helpful and location is excellent. Nice common area in the lounge to hangout

Location is strategic. Opposite the hotel
Located a nice noodle shop. Staffs service are excellent. The room is cleaned and spacious too. They provide  complimentary snacks (milk, coffee, toast, bun, bao etc) in the morning at the pantry area. Nothing to complain, valuable for money.

The hotel and the room represents a comfy and satisfied environment, which provides exactly what you needed. The inclusive breakfast was good too. The staff was very nice and helpful.

There is a pity due to the limited time and concerns of using laundry machine, so we have to use coin machine nearby the hotel.

Overall, Its still a high satisfactory and highly recommended hotel for budget travellers.

reviews.text: We specially booked a room with a bathtub, but it was already 12:30 in the evening and there was no hot water in the middle of the shower! ! When we originally wanted to take a bath, we had to take a cold bath instead, which caused us to go to the doctor for a cold. It was very late and there was no staff available to help. When we contacted the counter the next day, we were told that maybe because the floor was full that day and everyone was using water, there was no hot water! ? You should take care of the hot water part of the hotel yourself, instead of using the excuse that everyone was using water because the floor was full that day! ! ! Later, I saw that a lot of people on your own Google comments had already reported this problem, but it still didn’t get resolved! ! !

As soon as we entered the room, it was filled with mold. The floor was all raised up (it felt like they didn't care if we commented). You can safely park your bike in a quiet area around here. The entrance and room PIN numbers will be emailed to you the day before and you can self-check in! When you check out, you leave your accommodation fee on the table in your room, take a photo, and leave. It was my first time doing it completely on my own, but it went smoothly without any problems. Amazing system!

I came to Tainan on a budget and didn’t want to be too far from the city center. I happened to see OAOA’s FB introduction and asked the owner about the room type and price. I found that it was much lower than our budget!
The boss replies quickly to messages! Originally, we wanted five people to share a room so that we could get together and play together at night, but because we couldn't add extra beds, we could only book two rooms. The boss was kind enough to help us arrange a room on the first floor that happened to be next door! The room is large and clean with a light wood smell. The decoration is retro and clean. Unfortunately, I forgot to take pictures.
The soundproofing is not very good, but it's not so noisy that I can't sleep. It's really a good deal for the price.
We had a great time during these three days! Thank you boss

Why am I so disappointed? Because I have been keeping it since I saw someone unboxing it for a trip a long time ago. I decided to make the decision immediately after arriving in Tainan, but the result was terrible👎

What greeted me was the characteristic door I was looking forward to. After contacting the landlord and giving him the password to open the door, I felt very happy on the first floor.
The room is on the second floor. The stairs are steep and very narrow. It is not easy to carry a 28-inch suitcase. But that still doesn't affect my expectations.
After going upstairs, I saw the thin wooden doors of the three rooms next to each other. I had a bad feeling at first. I guess I could hear the sound coming in and out.
After entering the room, because we had traveled more than four hours by car, we went to the bathroom first. Being a mysophobic person, my heart dropped because there was actually toilet paper used by others in the toilet!
After walking out of the bathroom, there was someone else's shark clip stuck on the curtain leading to the balcony.
But because we were in a hurry to pack our luggage and makeup and prepare to go to the Luermen Notre Dame Temple for fireworks, my husband flushed the toilet while my mind was still running, so I just forgot about it.
After that, while I was sorting out, I could vaguely hear the sound of other people chatting, and I was still praying secretly. We also found a problem with few sockets, but we had a power bank so it was manageable. I also noticed that there was a frosted glass window on the door. Although I couldn't see through it, I still felt that there was a lack of privacy.

After finishing the night's itinerary, return to the B&B room and go to the bathroom first.
In the bathtub, there is no faucet in the bathtub, and water can only be discharged through the shower head in the shower area. First, I ran the hottest water through the bathtub for about a minute. When the dirty water leaked from the bathtub, I discovered that there was no pipeline connected to the drain hole, and it would flow to the shower area and washbasin area, which meant that the entire floor became slippery.

After plugging it, the water in the bathtub was filled, and I removed my makeup at the sink. Originally, the hot water would be hot when I turned on the bathtub, but when I wanted to wash my face, it became room temperature! And after washing it three times, I thought I hadn't washed it thoroughly because it always felt slippery. After subsequent washings, I guessed it was a water quality issue.

When I started taking a shower, I found that the wall-mounted shower head was very high and not suitable for most girls, and the water was indeed lukewarm. In a dilemma, I decided to take a bath first and wait for the hot water. I soaked for five songs, which was at least 15 minutes. I needed to take a shower with room temperature water or warmer. With the low temperature alarm in Taiwan, I could only wash my hair, jump back into the bathtub to wait for the water temperature, conditioner, jump back into the bathtub to wait for the water temperature, wash my body and jump back into the bathtub to wait for the water temperature... There were many trips back and forth, and the storage racks and clothes racks were far away. It was very inconvenient to get any supplies, and it was physically and mentally tortured.

After the battle was finally over, there was no socket in the bathroom, so I had to dry my hair in the bedroom and then tidy up in front of the wet mirror in the bathroom.

After lying down, the husband explained that during the rest, he could hear the movements of the tenants in the other four rooms. The sound insulation was not bad enough. Some were talking and chatting, some were sleeping until snoring, some were washing, and some were applauding for love. It didn't end until three or four in the morning. I immediately sent a message to the hotel, but there has been no reply at 8 o'clock in the evening. Maybe it doesn't matter because the money has been collected.

When I woke up in the morning, the housekeepers who had checked out early were already being tidied up. There were sounds of breaking things, vacuum cleaners, and even changing bed sheets. Those who said the soundproofing was good probably didn't have other guests when they checked in!

A superficial bathroom, a double bed, a low temperature alarm, a thin quilt, and all kinds of noise. We swear it was the worst hotel experience in our lives as a couple.

If it is deleted, I will post it again.

reviews.text: Stayed for 2 nights on 30 Nov and 1 Dec. Arrived at hotel before 1pm. We met this bad attitude young female receptionist. She told us to leave our luggage near the lift lobby by ourselves and come back at 3pm. Then she just left and went to the toilet.  What a "warm" welcome. We went to the 1st floor toilet after her and found the floor wet and disgusting.Fortunately when we came back to check-in later in the afternoon we were met by a friendly young male staff who also offered to  help us book a taxi to the train station when we checked out. The room spacious for 2 people, shower pressure good. Convenient location. Breakfast was basic.

Style and good location. The front desk staff was impressive - Ye Xun (業勳) was very friendly and helpful. He was very responsive to our needs and always had a smile on his face.

My boss stayed at several hotels during his business trip to Taiwan and also thought he was a very enthusiastic hotel employee (other staffs may need to be smiley and be friendlier XD)

Overall, it's value for money.
Central location, clean and stylish interior, and excellent service. Breakfast modest selection is mostly local flavor.

Good location and easy to get around with the buses. Although you really need the public transport app to know the times for the buses. You can’t rely on the published timetable. The room is decent but there are two issues I see. Firstly, the mini fridge doesn’t really get cold. It’s more of a cooler that keeps things cool, not cold. No thermostat so a but useless. The toilet has no floor to ceiling door. So the smell from the toilet will stay in the room for some time. If there are two of you, prepare for bad smells. This is not a good design but I see you are trying to be modern.

The staff are nice when checking in and for breakfast.

The room cleaning is extremely slow. We went out in the morning and it still wasn’t cleaned by 3pm. We ended up telling them to just give us towel and not worry about the room. When we arrived to go to the room at 3 pm ( check in time), the staff had to run upstairs before us to check if the room was done.

Also if you want the air conditioner lower than 23, just ring the front desk.

reviews.text: Bad hygiene, poor service, rude front desk service must be improved, don't even want to give a star
Clean, very small rooms, a bit smelly

Good for international travelers, great value for money. Helpful and professional staff members who speak good English.

Rooms are small, but modern and well-designed, with all the amenities you would expect. Very quiet, good mattresses, comfortable.

The extended breakfast buffet is nice, but clearly only intended for regional guests, and has little to offer for the more conservative Western traveler. In spite of what the name of the hotel implies, the food is certainly not kosher.

I’ve stayed here at least five times but still can’t figure out why it is called Talmud or why it is marketed as a “Jewish” themed hotel; it feels like a randomly chosen concept.

Recommended for travelers who want a quiet, unassuming and comfortable hotel for a good price.

A very nice hotel located in the small township. Customer service is excellent. Anticipating guest needs whenever seek.
Rooms for 2pax are comfortable but not to big. Basic amenities are available with reasonable quality. Beds are comfortable and clean.
Breakfast spread are simple and nice. Do be prepared to clear your own dishes and place them on the dish cart. You are also advice to separate your waste as per indicated. Taiwan is practising waste separation hence this hotel is adopting the practice. Service crew is also available around to clean the table after guest leave before anticipating another guest.
Just nearby there is a FAMILY MART convenient store. For the ladies whom are looking for facial essential, make up and mask essentials...there is also a store located just by this hotel and opens till 11pm.

Swift check in, polite staff, nice location, affordable price for stay, recommended.
PS. Parking is convenient for both four wheels and motorcycles.

reviews.text: Everything was excellent! The room was great, the amenities were top-notch, and the breakfast was fantastic ( Chinese food 2nd floor). Best hotel to stay. Excellent location with everything nearby. The rooms are spacious, clean and comfortable. Suggest to stay in the executive floor where you can taste sumptuous breakfast with drinks through the day. Staff is friendly. What's more, the restaurants are must try. We had the seasonal menu in Robin's with the famous Rouge Duck   The outdoor swimming pool with a bar serving creative tea cocktails and live music is sensational

The bedroom while large needs a refresh and the shower head adjustment need’s adjusting.

reviews.text: The design of the hostel is cool and cozy. The stuff is very kind. The dorms are a bit small but comfortable and clean.

I had a really lovely stay at Fuqi Hostel. The hostel surprised me positively from the bottom to the top (literally). I was first received by a really cosily decorated entrance; however, it was not just a deceptive shell, as the receptionist greeting me was really friendly and showed me all the facilities on the 1st floor (ground floor for British people)—there are sofas and a long table chill at, three guitars, a small in- and outdoor garden, and a kitchen area with free tea, coffee and biscuits. There was also a self-serve shop with a jar you could leave cash in, which I found reflected the hostel's friendly and trusting atmosphere.

The receptionist afterwards took me up the step stairs; first, to the second floor (where guys aren't allowed), then to the third floor, which has mixed dorms. It was a six person dorm room designed like a capsule hostel, just with partitions made of cloth. I personally prefer solid walls for my capsules, but it worked okay with cloth too.

Finally, there was the shower and bathroom area. The showers and toilet themselves were in separate, enclosed rooms, with the sinks and hair dryers located in the area just outside. This outside area had no walls on two sides, so it was properly outside—which I loved! To me, it emphasised that I was in a tropical country (an open bathroom like that would've had few visitors in my home country of Norway ❄️). It was great! There was even a small balcony with two chairs and a transparent floor right next to the bathroom.

On the fourth floor, there was space for drying clothes and towels. Here, you could get an even better view out on the surroundings.

The only thing to be careful about is that is that if you bring valuables to the hostel during your stay, since the locks on some of the lockers don't work.

In conclusion, Fuqi hostel is an absolutely wonderful place to stay. The other guests I met were also really friendly. So, if you are coming to Tainan, I warmly recommend Fuqi Hostel (:

Fuqi hostel was such a great find! Super friendly staff, awesome location to food, culture and sights in Tainan! The hostel itself is very clean, friendly and well kept. I felt very comfortable here and would have loved to stay longer and if I’m ever in the area again I would definitely stay here!

After 6 months traveling Asia, this is the best hostel i have been. Is centric, clean and beautiful.
The manager await for me because I was arriving late in night.
Everything is really made with care and love, if every business would care this much for all the details, world would be so much better.

Everything works and is how has to be: hangers in the bed, free drinking water (hot and cold), soap, paper, lights, showers and toilettes all is perfect.
Also has many artworks around what makes it even more beautiful.

Really good hostel 100% recommended.

If you want to travel to Tainan, don’t miss this place. The boss and staff here are very amiable and everyone welcomes you.
The environment inside is comfortable and antique, which is very suitable for taking pictures and resting.
The hygiene inside is very good, and sterilized slippers are provided. Even the cups are sterilized. The bed was also very comfortable.
The location is also very close to the tourist area, and you can visit many places within walking distance.

reviews.text: Disrespectful to non chinese speakers!   I made a reservation on booking.com the day prior around 15h00 to arriving in Tainan, with website specifying that NO PREPAYMENT was needed, including my LINE account in the booking message to the homestay as I know some hotels will ask for a deposit; I explained to them my arrival mode + time, asking them to contact me directly on LINE if any issues.  I never got any LINE message from the establishment.  The next day I checked the address of the homestay to make my way to it, to realize they had simply canceled my booking!  They messaged me on booking.com about 30 min after my reservation, in Chinese only!  I later realized they indeed wanted me to contact them!  I added their LINE before heading to the hotel, asking for explanations, trying to find out if they still had a room, apologizing that I cannot speak Chinese, and showing that my LINE does not provide translation! They sent me screen shots of their messages in Chinese on booking site, which I could not translate (being only on my phone).   They simply stopped replying to my messages!  This is not respectful to tourists from foreign countries, contrarily to the overwhelming majority of Taiwanese people who go out of their way to help. Shame on you.

The Lost Circle.
Clean, nicely decorated and spacious room with a kitchen, fridge, heater, fan, washing machine in side the room. Our friend book the room for us so we did not know that the check in time is until 6pm and was caught by suprise when arrived at the address and see an apparently closed building. However the friendly neighbors call the guy and he arrived in about 10 mins to led us in.
Complimentary is 2 milk tea in the fridge.
Except the hiccup when we arrived, I'm satisfied with the stay.

First time staying here, not far from the station. The environment is very good. In the alley, we booked a building in a building for 2 nights. The disadvantage is that we have to climb stairs on the 4th floor. The sound insulation is good. There is a fourth TV and wifi is provided. It's very close to the Confucius Temple and you can reach it by walking.

This B&B is really amazing! I have been to Tainan for three times, and I ranked it first. The room I stayed in this time was a quadruple room in the building. There is a large refrigerator in the room, so you don’t have to worry about not having a place to keep food and drinks cold. There is even an IH stove! There are all kinds of pots, bowls, dishes and cutlery. Tainan is most famous for its snacks~ But sometimes there are so many snack bars that I want to eat, and sometimes I feel embarrassed to order too little for internal use with friends. When staying at this B&B, you can take a small amount and heat it yourself and share it with your friends. The hot water temperature of the B&B is also super high and the pressure is super high, making it super refreshing and comfortable to take a bath! ! There are also blankets in the dining and chatting area in the living room, which is extremely comfortable. I think it is very thoughtful to live in a high-ceiling space like a building in the middle of the building. There are also 2 air conditioners. In summer, there will be no situation where the upper and lower floors are not cold at all. It is really a very considerate B&B!
9月底住了2晚運氣很好遇到台南在迎媽祖，整個城市真的非常熱鬧，文化氣氛滿滿。二樓房間隔音不錯，外面的聲音其蠻小聲的，二個人住空間真的蠻大的，且有廚房 冰箱 洗衣機 餐桌 ，地點也很方便，不遠的圓環口 文學館 消防文史館 開山路後面孔廟 美術館一館 林百貨都是幾分鐘距離 ，住宿的巷子後面是六合境清水寺再右轉居然就是有名的包子祿，便利商店的話要走路5分左右，真的是間很棒的民宿 ，很讚!

reviews.text: The room is comfortable and clean. Recommend to those ppl visiting Tainan!❤️.

We made a reservation through Booking. After completing the order, we will receive a reply and can join the official LINE. If the payment is completed within three days, the reservation is successful. The service staff are very friendly. If you have any questions, they respond quickly!

The location of the B&B is good, with convenient transportation and many nearby attractions.
This B&B adopts a self-service check-in system. The password for the electronic lock of the guest's door will be provided in the message on the day. If you arrive early, you can store your luggage in the public area first. You only need to inform the B&B owner. Because it is a self-service hotel, you have free time, and you can check in from 16:00.

We stayed in a quadruple room that day. The room was very spacious and had a balcony. The environment was very clean and comfortable. The bathroom had wet and dry separation. Clothes hangers, towels, bath products, and hair dryers (with sufficient air volume) are provided.

There is no elevator in the B&B, and the highest floor is the 4th floor. Room types are randomly arranged. If you have special needs (difficulty in mobility, a lot of luggage, etc.), you can inform us in advance and let the B&B make arrangements.

There was a notice posted outside the bathroom, recommending that each person take a shower 30 minutes apart, because we were afraid that too much water would run out of hot water. However, the four of us took showers that day and the water did not turn cold, but it heated up slower~

If you ride a motorcycle, you can park directly in the indoor space on the first floor of the B&B. If you drive, you need to find another parking space. There is a parking lot diagonally opposite, and there are many that do not charge parking fees. The B&B provides a shared location: Junping Road free public parking lot, address: "opposite" No. 246 Junping Road, Anping District, Tainan City.

Finally, we summarize a few points that may be of more concern to you:
No breakfast, no invoice (with receipt), no elevator, no car parking space, no pets, no extra bed service, no smoking and no drugs!
The environment is clean and tidy, the service is friendly, parent-child friendly (there are also children's toys in the public area), the transportation is convenient, rooms can be reserved, there is a cooperative motorcycle dealer plan, and canal tour tickets are sold on behalf of others...

There is too much other information so I won’t continue to list it. For details, you can contact the B&B in person~ In short, I personally think it is great to stay here. I slept very well that night. I will want to stay here again if I have the opportunity in the future!

1. 熱水一個人洗完還得等半小時才有熱水

reviews.text: Its a budget-friendly hotel rooms. We've stay here for 2 nights the room is clean and quite good. But there is a limited English channels on TV and there is no available coffee. But its a good place to stay for a tight-budget traveler..

Weird hotel. We were here a few nights. Up on the 10th floor initially, until it started raining heavily and there was a leak from the ceiling above the window in the evening. We reported this at the reception and they offered a new smaller room with no windows, on the same floor. If we wanted one with a window they said we would have to check out of the first room at 11am and come back at 3pm even though the leak was not our fault. As if they would just open the leaky room to someone else that day…
We were then offered a family sized room upgrade on the 8th floor. It was perhaps a little larger with laminate flooring instead of old carpet, but the aircon system was old, there was water coming up from the bathroom floor (from the toilet I think) and we found a cockroach in our room. There is a balcony but there was water on the ground there so it wasn’t really an option to use it. It seems the building needs a fair amount of renovation. It was relatively clean in terms of sheets etc, both rooms had working fridges, hairdryers, bottled water and tea making facilities. Location is decent.
Would I stay here again? Probably not.

The location is not too bad as it is walkable to a few attractions such as Chikan Tower, although it feels rather shady. The room is spacious, but it is quite old and run down, while the toilet has a strong unpleasant smell. The noise isolation is also quite bad as we can hear the knocking of walls from the adjacent room. Price is a little high. The staff are friendly and easy check in/check out process.
It is hardly park vehicles but the location is better for travelers. The service isn't very well but require to improve.

Not the best nor the worst of the hotel. I believe in price deems the condition. But doesn’t mean a five stars hotel can be great too. This is located quite far(1km away) from Tainan train station. By walking is about 25mins. Hotel reception is located at level8. Staffs is friendly and willing to explain to you on the location that you wanted to go. The rooms does have a musk smell whenever you open the door. Room is kind of big. Bed is damm soft lah. For the price you are paying. Is what you are getting.

reviews.text: The hotel is a steal for its price range. Contradicting to other reviews, I was very satisfied with my stay with Beauty Hotels Bnight. Improvements will be front desk. Location is the struggle, its kinda far from MRT lines. Positives: Good room, good amenities, FREE COOKIES! Improvements: Front desk service and location (you can always choose a stay near MRT). a generous 4.5 stars out of 5.

Rooms were fine, pleasant bed and enough space. Spacious bathroom! Yet self check in was horrible, from any trip coming into a hotel where there is nobody to welcome you and the person on the phone you can dial in cannot speak English and can’t help you with Check-In in, made me feel more tired than I already was after a flight.
Then the neighborhood is quite shabby, almost dirty from what I’ve seen of Taipei. The lobby where to get the lifts up to the room is dirty and not inviting, far from how any hotel is looking like. The location has a lot of convenient stores and restaurants but still far walking to the metro station. I would never stay here anymore or recommend this hotel to anyone. Thank god the rooms were clean and well, spacious but overall experience wasn’t a good impression on Taipei as a city (unfortunately)..

clean/comfy beds + courteous housekeeping staff.

However, the hotel requires check-out at 1100. I overlooked this and thought that check out is 1200.

The staff called at 1100 and then 1115 to ask that I check-out. Which left me packing in a frenzy. At the reception table at 1120 - staff insisted that I MUST pay NT$200 as late charge for checking out 20min late.

I would suggest potential guests to book hotels that allows 1200 checkout time.

My three nights of staying here with my husband was priceless. Bed was so comfortable. Breakfast for me is delicious. Though my husband was too picky when it comes to foods hes able to eat breakfast here too. I just dont like the stinky smell of the elevator. I hope the management can fix it. But still this hotel is recommended

Clean modern hotel. Comfortable beds. Good housekeeping service. Only drawback is because the hotel shares with residences and a karaoke club, walls are thin and can hear noise at night. If you are a light sleeper, this may not be the place for you. Otherwise, good value for the price.

reviews.text: We stayed only one night at this hotel while transit at Taoyuan airport. It was a convenient location to find food and small shopping. Hotel reception was located at 6 floor and not easy to find. Once you were inside, you’re surprised to see how spacious and clean it is. The staff was very kind and polite. We arrived at 9pm and he helped us to check in. Next morning we left at 6:50am, it was still same person. He helped us to find the taxi we booked in a cold wet morning. Thank you and highly recommend to traveler  who need to transit or connect a flight

Great location but the walls and the windows are paper thin. We stayed on the 6th floor and can still hear all of the conversations and sneezes on the streets. There was also couple of mosquitoes everyday in our room. The sheets didn’t seem to be changed but instead just tucked away daily, our sheets had weird blood looking stains on them and when there were replaced it was a different stain. The shopping area across the street is a good time but it’s always very loud and weekends have a loud concert going on. There was also a matter of the staff not saying anything to loud neighbors on the floor. Besides the negatives, the staff were nice and the cleaning ladies are doing a great job cleaning fast, the shower and towels were always clean. Will most likely not be staying here again as there are plenty of better options out here.

Great place!! Rooms are super clean, staff is accommodating. For those complaining about the smell to get up the elevator... Literally all of Asia smells similar so get over it. You're not staying in the elevator.

The housekeeping literally folded my clothes! Everything is available: toothbrush, qtips, combs etc . Service is impeccable and cleanliness can't be beat.

If you're over 6'5, beware you may have to duck, but other than that. No complaints.

Rooms are reasonably sized and clean. Check is fairly quick and the location is great. Just take note that they are not Taoyuan train station and NOT the Taoyuan High Speed Rail station.

Biggest issue is the route to the lift. The area is filled with stalls selling food and unfortunately, the cleanliness is much to be desired and the alley smells - it is not welcoming and rather nauseating to be honest so, you'll have to brave that before you head up to the hotel.

This is definitely a five-star. Excellent service, nice clean spacious rooms. Buffet style dinner and breakfast both were delicious. Reception staff arranged large taxi for us because we have two bicycles. You are only 15 minutes from the airport. I would definitely stay again.

reviews.text:
The only downside of staying here is the number of loo and shower they have - they have plenty of dormitory rooms which means guests and it's gonna be packed during peak hours (before 8am and after 8pm) - and the absence of luggage lockers for the guests (in your dorm room you'll just leave your luggage nearby or down if you're at the top bunk then pray nobody will get it. Just a few minutes walk from the nearest MRT station.

Their breakfast buffet is superb!! Plenty of choices -- they label vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes!! Something recommended!

They also allow you to leave your luggage with them after you checkout and come get it later!

Very bad experience at the cu hotel. They don't accept bit early checkin need to wait until 3pm, they don't provide towel or breakfast if you are in share room. You have to pay for a key locker.
I was a bit sick and the ac is either too cold or too hot and blows lot of air all the time so I'm even more sick. I was not able to sleep because the other roommate were coming and going all the time switching on the light and snoring very strong. They could have included me breakfast to compensate. The bathroom share is not clean nor convenient. It is also very expensive a share bed on the ground for what they don't offer. I don't recommend you to go

The room was good and tidy but small. breakfast: they falsely labelled meat dumplings as vegetarian. The milk tea and orange juice are too sweet for my taste. No water was provided at the buffet, but there is a water dispenser near the elevator. Staff was friendly. Location was good.

I picked this hotel for it's convenient location to where I needed to be early morning next day. I was a little concerned about the self check-in, as sometimes those things can go wrong. Luckily, this wasn't the case with this hotel. The self check-in machine was fairly straightforward to use, and once I checked in, I had to find a staff member to receive my room key. There was an option of renting a locker, but since I wasn't leaving the hotel in the evening, and departing super early the next morning, I didn't rent one.

The room itself is small, but comfortably spacious with interesting and convenient arrangement of the beds. The bathroom wasn't too far and was clean with warm water available. The hotel is quite big, but it is sectioned, so it is not difficult to navigate around, or find the closest kitchen area, lounge area, or the bathroom.

I really enjoyed my stay here, and if I need to stay in the area again, I will most certainly come back.

Booked 4 nights in this hotel and won’t do it again for sure. Womens on reception are fine,but 2 mans who are working there were very rude with me and one young boy even started to yell at me! I booked single occupancy room and next day my bf supposed to come ,I didn’t wanted to change room and asked woman in the morning if can stay together with him next day ,she said yes no problem,cuz full bed is the same , when I wanted to pay for another night in the evening this boy started to shout that I need to change room in the morning,then I said I don’t want to stay in this hotel anymore. It’s very old inside ,they clean and change towels only once for 3 days ,and not acceptable when staff is rude. Try to avoid this hotel ,there are so many other options.

The staff said I had to wait a bit but for after one whole hour the air-con still isn’t working and I couldn’t stand the weird smell… likely caused by the humidity. Staff at the reception wasn’t exactly welcoming either. He was unwilling to answer questions most of the time. Curt responses and bad attitude.

reviews.text:
Not recommended!

The location of the hostel is okay, but unfortunately, that was the only positive aspect of our stay. Our private room was extremely small and had no window, which made it feel cramped and uncomfortable. On top of that, the bathroom was heavily infested with mold – completely unacceptable.

The most frustrating part was how they handled our canceled first night. Our flight to Taipei was canceled, so we arrived a day later than planned. Upon check-in, the receptionist assured us that we would receive a refund for the missed night if we provided proof via email. Despite sending the airline’s correspondence and additional documents, our refund was ultimately denied without a clear explanation. Supposedly, the manager decided that we wouldn’t get our money back because the flight was canceled by a third-party booking service rather than the airline itself. We never received a proper explanation – communication was extremely difficult due to poor English skills, and when we asked for the manager’s contact details, they refused to provide them.

Overall, our stay was disappointing. Tiny rooms, unreliable service, and a lack of transparency. We cannot recommend this hostel.

First time staying at a hostel ever, and my friend Nicole choosing Meander Taipei was a great choice since she didn’t want to traumatize my first experience with hostels. Polite and helpful staff. People are friendly but leave you alone when you want them to. Clean rooms (and I’m picky when it comes to rooms). Clean, heated toilet seats. Shower rooms with blow dryers, sanitary napkins, shower caps, and cotton buds. Free coffee and tea. Walking distance to convenience stores and food stalls. It’s right next to a cat café too. No elevator from 1st-2nd floor though. Overall, good stay!

I stayed here for a couple of months this time because my experience last year, even during a shorter stay, was absolutely incredible! The Halloween and Christmas events hosted by the amazing staff were so much fun and added to the festive atmosphere. It’s super convenient to find a quiet workspace, relax in the lounge, or take care of laundry and cooking whenever you need to. The women’s dorm was spotless and well-maintained, and the staff went above and beyond to help with travel tips and anything else I needed. I truly loved my time here and highly recommend it to anyone looking to meet friendly locals and international travelers while making their Taipei trip unforgettable!

Great location, just next to lots of different of restaurants. 24 hour lobby with kitchen, workplaces and laundry room. The people here is really friendly and they were helpful. The rooms were clean and had a very warm atmosphere. Recommended. I booked 4 person room. Another great idea of this hostel is of a minibar. It’s replenished on Saturdays so it’s a good time to book on a Saturday. :P and it’s free

Excellent location only a short walk to Ximen station, the rainbow crossing and shopping district. Spacious clean dorms, lots of amenities in the clean shared bathrooms. Huge communal area with well stocked kitchen. Highly recommend from the UK as a solo female traveller
