reviews.text:
We chose this hotel because we stayed here a few times before between 2015 and 2018. It has a great location and the rooms were quite nice.

Were.

Things have gone downhill. The hallway had a really bad smell, and the first room they put us in also didn’t smell good. We asked for a different one and the new room was only slightly better. But still filthy.

The laminate on the windowsills have peeled up indicating leaky windows and walls probably filled with toxic mould. The wallpaper and carpet are significantly blackened. Then I looked for a power outlet near the bed and found something horrible. Basically a hole in the wall, with a bird nest of cables all covered by a 2mm layer of dust. Just casually covered by the nightstand. I am not putting my hands anywhere near there. I don't know what's nesting inside that icky spider hole and I don't want to find out.

The room also had some mechanical issues — the heater was inadequate and the hot water faucet ran at barely a trickle. I had to use a drinking cup to shave because I couldn’t fill the sink with hot water.

We cut our stay short and moved to another hotel. I don’t feel safe or comfortable here. This room, in its current condition, is unfit for human habitation.

When we explained the problem as we checked out, the only thing they offered was an upgrade, saying it’s because we booked a small room. We explained multiple times that the problem was the condition, not the size. They were not willing to refund the remaining hotel stay. They kept our money and I'm angry.

We stayed at Caesar Park Taipei in late February/early March as a stopover for one night on our way to Kenting and one night on our way back to Toronto. The location is super convenient, close to the high speed train station, although the signage in the underground could be better, but this is not the hotel's fault. Its also close to the underground shops and to a lot of good cheap street vendors/little shops which offer superb value. The staff are generally very helpful. An added bonus is the storage of luggage free of charge if you are coming back to the hotel after checking out and left for another destination. That was a great help, because its less hassle and its free and provide better peace of mind than storage at the train station. Rooms have been renovated and clean and big. Will definitely stay again.

Great location in the heart of Taipei. Accessible from MRT directly to your room just need to change the elevator on first floor. To me, it's very convenient but not exactly 5 stars hotel.

Breakfast is nice. Room is comfortable, and just clean not extra clean.

The hotel is very well located (close to many bus stops and metro stations and in lively neighborhood). The room is very decent.
However, the service left a lot to be desired. I checked-in with a group. It took a lot of time because of inefficiencies from staff members. Worse still they apologized superficially. In addition what upset us even more was the discriminatory behaviors of some staff members. There was a café in front of the reception, where guests could sit around. We saw three Caucasian guests eating their snacks there, so two of us decided to eat our own snacks too. Yet we were told that it was not allowed, while the Caucasian guests could take liberty to do so.

Don’t. Book. This. Hotel. Nightmare!
This hotel is totally a lie. Their lobby is nice, represent a 5 star hotel, no doubt. We booked a single room because we only expect a clean, safe and a convenient hotel location for visiting our friends and family. However, when we arrived our room, it was a very smelly, heavy humid and moldy. I immediately called the lobby and requested to change a new room. They agreed and get us another room. The 2nd room is only slightly better, no weird smell, but extremely old, and dirty. The carpet is very old, the wall paper is peeling with “mold”, there is only one small round table with a tiny chair in the corner… all the atmosphere, condition made me wonder, am I in a 5 star hotel? Then I walked into bathroom, the shower room is not clean, I can see a thousand layers of soap scum next to the shower head and I can imagine how many people before us had to use this poor bath room. This is the first time I feel this space is not safe, and everything is nearly broken. Since we didn’t want to make too complicated situation, we still unpack our stuff and charge our phone first. Then.. we just realized the closest place to our bed for charging our phone is this bird nest (below picture) that was completely freaking us out!  My husband can’t stand with this hotel anymore, he would like to request a refund. We told the lobby front desk, they rejected to give us a refund but offer an upgrade room for us. They keep saying what we booked is a single room, not a suite. They did remodel the suite room but not single room for long time. (Oh, so this was our fault to book a single room?) I told them it’s not about the room size, it’s about the room condition, you made us feel like refugees! After changing to the 2nd room, we were not interested in this hotel anymore. We just want to leave! Obviously this hotel doesn’t care because they have one of the best locations in Taipei and they will not care about a single customer’s response. I wrote this down because I hate their arrogance and refuse to admit their fault. I will not recommend this hotel, it’s the worst experience, and it ruined our evening. Please don’t be fooled by their lobby. The inside of the room is utter crap.

reviews.text: Regarding accommodation quality, it's crucial to be transparent about the hotel's star rating in Taipei. Deduct at least one or two stars to get a true reflection of its standing. Anyone who has stayed at multiple Check-Inn properties in Taiwan knows they can be a gigantic mixed bag with fluctuating levels of comfort. The NeiHu property, in particular, desperately needs updates. Room screams budget-quality, ignore the photo editing of rooms on booking portals. Please fix the hot water issues, as despite the maintenance engineer's claim of fixing it on the last day of our two-day stay, it remained unresolved. The desk light fixture's electrical outlet was non-operational, and the most significant issue was the serious mold odor. A humidifier was brought up on our last day, which helped briefly, but the mold smell quickly returned due to decades of accumulation. Additionally, water spillage from the shower stall through glass crevices led to water accumulation on the bathroom floor. The local area also lacks enough dining options, so be aware that the neighborhood is mostly newly-built residential housing.

**Warning: hotel makes withdrawal on your bank account ** you definitely should remind them and follow the "process" which takes 2 months. I booked via Agoda, paid cash at the hotel; still they did this! Absurd!!!

Large room in an inexpensive price range; facility is clean & the staff is friendly. The breakfast buffet is only NT$200 each for hotel customers - very good price but needs tea bags for tea drinkers.

Friendly n fast check-in services. Rooms are decent.  Room rate is excellent.  If u care less about MRT, there are plenty of buses n UBikes around the corner.

Morning breakfast buffet is a must.  Services are great n food is delicious n plenty.

The bed is really soft and big.
There is a bathtub and standing shower in my room.
The view is also decent.
I requested a lot of stuff during my stay (toilet paper, trash bags, soap, water bottles, etc..) and they always delivered in a timely manner.
I used line to message the hotel and they always responded quickly.
They also delivered 3 meals a day to my room and most of them tasted delicious.

reviews.text:
I initially booked a few days with them via Booking.com but even though the reservation details stated I'd only pay at the property, they tried to charge me more than half of the full amount right away.
I understand there was a disclaimer about a potential deposit to be refunded in full later, supposedly to confirm the validity of the card used but if that's the case, does it /really/ have to be half of the original charge?
Either way, I just found them suspicious, so I ended up cancelling my reservation. (Or rather it got automatically cancelled after the hotel arbitrarily rejected the card I use on a regular basis for purchases made in foreign currencies. Good riddance! )

Strategically located- just a few minutes walk to Fuzhong station (blue line) which has direct connection to Ximen and Taipei Main Station.

Room- is spacious enough for a solo traveler like me. I can freely open my luggage. The bed is also comfortable. Everything you would need is provided and there's a daily cleaning service so you will return to your room relaxed after a tiring day. I was provided a corner room so the view is also spectacular.

Surroundings - has a lot to offer. There's a 7/ 11 and McDonald's a few steps away from the hotel. There's also a good fried chicken shop below the hotel.

Price - cheaper when compared to other centrally located hotels in ximending.

Overall, this is highly recommended .

Warning: if you expect an ordinary standard hotel, this is NOT. One star is to appreciate cleaning staffs and the reception staffs who are nice. The room was extremely small, in a degree that you wouldn’t be able to totally relax due to suffocation by the space. There’s not enough space to even have a piece of surface(table?) for backpacks or handbags or hanging the second coat. You might be able to put snacks, drinks on the TV table. Open the Luggage? It would block half of your walking space. The bathroom is very tiny. Mine is a corner triangle bathroom that I could only stood by the toilet to have a shower. After shower, everything was wet. Opening the windows in the bathroom for ventilation would be a bad idea. Because of no mesh, mosquitos sneaked in. The hotel told me they have no solutions for mosquitos. The wet bathroom made everything wet, hanging towels in the bathroom was impossible to get dry. Moisture invaded to sleeping area, no surprise mold was spotted by the ventilation grille. Also If you are unlucky enough like me, encountering bad neighbors smoking in their rooms or somewhere, the AC will bring you cancerous smoke and the hotel staffs won’t do anything to stop it. If you expect water kettle, fridge, or mugs, they don’t exist. There are two bottles of water for you every time after cleaning. The shared fridge and filtered water is outside of the room. A famous(? I was told) Taiwanese fried pop chicken and more is right downstair. Hotel is close to the subway station and the blue line is right toward downtown Taipei which is convenient. Price is affordable, but I regret not being generous to myself.

The singel  room  with the window(you really don't need the window as you keep it covered due to the privacy and the traffic sounds loud) is fine, but there is a mould in the bathroom and it gave me a thore throat. I was glad that i stayed only 1 night. The shower is placed over the toilette, jail style i would guess... You can get hot water from the dispenser on the 3rd floor, but no cups. If you keep the bathroom door closed the smell of the mould will not enter the room. The bed is comfy though.

Honestly not bad at all. Decent place to stay. Facilities is barebones. Staff are friendly. None of the staff speak english however we both used google translate. The bathroom serves as a wetroom.

Price is good. The hotel undercut the market as I came for the New Years countdown for 2024 so I am thankful for that.

As solo traveller my room was a bigger room compared to other reviewers.

Tip: you should bring your own supplies such as toothpaste, shower gels, slippers etc. I asked if they had soap, spare multi plug extension lead, steam iron to borrow but I got declined on all fronts. They do have a hair dryer though!

The area is pretty good. I find the most restaurants close a bit later than ones around Ximen. The area is quite populated too. The Banqiao MRT station just further up is massive and has a few big malls there.

reviews.text:
Not good. They pressure you to promise that you will give them a top Google review at check-in.
Be aware that there is a high probability that all the 5 star reviews you see recently were also offered this free room "upgrade" at check-in, to give 5 stars before they have even entered their rooms.
If you say you can't promise they keep asking saying they already arranged a room upgrade.
The boss of this hotel needs to stop making employees do this. The review system can't be trusted if this is the way companies game the review system.
If you want good reviews just give customers a good experience.
Other than this I would give it a 2.5 star. The rooms are grubby with mould, and there was no hot water from the shower even after letting it run to warm up for 5-10 minutes. I had a 40 minute window to shower and check out so did not have time to ask them to try to fix it.

December 31, 2023.
Please don't even consider to stay in this hotel.
The nightmare starts when we enter our room: stinky, humid, dirty. I check the restroom and I find long hair on the ground as well as on the walls. I go straight to the reception to complain, they tell me they don't have any other rooms available. five minutes later, they offer us a new room, but it is totally the same; and guess what? Restroom check...hair here and there.
No one apologizes for the inconvenience, they just tell us: if you want you can cancel your reservation and get a refund. No need to hear it twice, we were able to book another (and better) hotel with a good NYE deal. After I couple of hours, our room was still available online at the crazy price of 6.900 NTD. A fraud, what else?

Good to be here again in Taipei. This hotel is so nice and the price is so reasonable. They have ao much hotel facilities at the front desk like coffee and some snacks and it's available for 24hrs great 👍🏻 I feel very satisfied 🙏🏻🙏🏻

Not such great hotel , of course it is cheap but state of the bathroom is quite old as well! Nothing really to complain about but just be aware!  For breakfast if your order a coffee, wake up early otherwise it will be probably cold by 09.30am…

reviews.text: The location is really convenient. It’s less than a 5 minute walk to Taipei 101 and a red line subway station. There is also a small night market within 5 minutes. Lots of bus stops and convenience stores nearby too. The hostel itself is clean enough. I liked that each bed is its own “box”instead of did plain bunk beds like other hostels I’ve stayed in. Bathrooms are okay. They’re never really dry and the showers are small and making getting dressed annoying. They also don’t stock actual towels so bring your own or cough up the $39 NTD for a disposable body towel that doesn’t do much more than smear water around your body.

I finally understood why the hostel provides earplugs for free. It was really noisy when I stayed in the bunk bed closest to the door connecting the bathroom. There were many travelers in the same room. Some of them took a bath late at night, and some of them used a hair dryer really early in the morning. As a result, the door opened and closed repeatedly. However, the price is much cheaper compared to other hostels nearby, and I think this is why the hostel is still fully booked even on weekdays.

Plus, when I posted my review on the page, I noticed that one of the reviews mentioned something about a “sneak photos ,” and the host didn’t reply to that review(?). Actually, I think that the lack of privacy protection isn’t limited to just the bathrooms. The bunk bed rooms also offer very little privacy due to their interior design and arrangement. If you’re considering booking a room there, my advice is to please reconsider.

I stayed in a 1 bed room here. It's small and only has a bed and a desk, but it's everything that a solo traveler needs. The location is great and convenient, and the facilities and wifi are good as well.

reviews.text:
I'm giving it 1 star because I can't give 0.

We booked for a whole week, and the first day the bathroom got flooded, you can't go inside for like 6 hours after taking a shower since everything is wet.

Also, the hotel says their rooms are soundproof and it's a complete scam, we could hear the noise from the outside traffic the whole night, it's impossible to fall asleep, even if you're tired from the travel.

The ceiling is completely dirty and moldy, and we found some giant cockroaches on it.

They also charge you the whole reservation price even if you leave after checking, we left them after we saw all these things and they didn't refund us anything, they charged us for luxury price hotel in Taipei, and it's a complete scam.

It's been a complete nightmare staying here for 1 night, don't book here.

Would strongly recommend you find somewhere else to stay. The room was small, extremely humid, there were cockroaches, stains on the bedding, mould on the walls, dust everywhere, the AC was extremely noisy and the check-in procedure was tedious as there's no one to check you in, just a barely functional machine. On the plus side, the location is good and it was relatively affordable. The bed was reasonably comfortable, but the cleanliness really put me off, at any price.

I had a stay for two days. The hotel is budget friendly and easy to check in. They provide all the amenties as listed. I enjoyed the stay. For the price i booked this hotel is lot better compared to others around Taipei.

Stay is good, convenient to famous places you wanted to go in Taipei City. Its cheap but accommodation is okay, staff are helpful and pleasant. One negative comment is just the shower head, I hope you change it to a better one. All in all, I recommend this place for your stay in Taipei. 😊
The only good thing is it's near the park (5-10mins walk away), night market, and noodle place across the street. Never again will we stay in this place for our next Taiwan visit.

reviews.text:
Pros:
-room is spacious and has all the basic amenities
-bed and pillows are super comfortable
-cleaning staff did a great job keeping the room tidy and clean
-receptionists are polite and efficient
-price is reasonable for the room

Cons:
-although the hotel is next to the metro, the location itself feels very isolated and there’s pretty much nothing to do in the area, the area is not very walkable either with tons of traffic on busy and narrow streets and ongoing construction. Overall it feels like a somewhat rundown area. In addition, although the metro station is nearby, you’ll likely take at least two lines (i.e a transfer) if you want to go to any popular tourist spot
-the gym does not belong to the hotel, it’s 3 minutes walk from the hotel but the gym feels very crowded as the gym seems to have agreements with several nearby hotels while also running as an independent commercial gym so it’s quite busy

Overall, good hotel for a budget stay, the major downside is location. That said, taxis in Taiwan are pretty cheap so if you don’t mind spending time commuting to downtown area, it’s a good stay.

Great hotel with great service! The beds are really comfortable, there are nice places to sit outside and inside, and a good breakfast (possibility to choose between three options). We could leave our luggage in the hotel the day we checked out (which is also already later than most hotels, at 12 PM), and they gave us free noodles for the night the typhoon was there 🙏🏻
Good clean rooms. Nice staffs. Free coffee and tea from morning to afternoon. Convenient location to St Ignatius MRT station.

There are many things to love about this hotel. The negative is it requires a 40 min train ride from the city but the metro is easy, safe and efficient. As a bonus, there’s a direct bus to the National Palace which is 40 mins away (bus 815).

Here’s two things we loved.

1. The hotel gives you free access to the gym across the road and it’s excellent - far bigger and better than an ordinary hotel gym.

2. The rooms are spacious for Taiwan and extremely well designed to make life comfortable and easy. And you can open the door to the balcony for fresh air.

A very good hotel in a great location. I had a classic king room on the 11th floor and it was  very nice. Super comfy bed and the shower was great. The breakfast was very nice along with the 24/7 free coffee/tea/water. The staff are all professional and courteous. Overall I liked LaCle very much and would return.

reviews.text: For the asking price of about 10.000 NT$ for the 31 of December, I hoped for a properly cleaned room... There was no bad smell, but it was extremely dusty (I drop the phone on the night stand, and it got covered by dust and white particles) and I spotted quite some hair on the furniture and under the sink... The kettle was a mess, hair and food gunk inside and out... The outlets are so consumed that it wouldn't keep hold of the phone charger... But the place is well designed and arranged, just a pity for the poor cleaning...

Hands down the worst hotel/airbnb in Taiwan. The only saving grace is the free parking and free breakfast. They give you small bottles of shampoo and bodywash that you had to ask for more everyday. The room has a strong odor like wet cloth. The room is covered by dirty carpet. I was late for check out, to be fair 38 minutes, and they charges me 400 Taiwan dollars. I was never late before in other hotels so I don't know if they also charges fees. However, charging 400 dollars is kind of outrages for being late less than an hour. Hotel staffs are passive aggressive, the only good staff is the young guy working night shift. Location is ok. But I would never come back here again, and I suggest you look elsewhere if you have alternatives.

Staff were friendly and location is excellent that close to everywhere
Room is kind of small. The shower area has mold and wall is too thin that can hear next door when people talk and shut the door
Good place to stay, free breakfast buffet in the morning. MRT station is right beside this hotel. Plenty of convenient stores and restaurants here. Very near to xiantian temple to visit!

pros: very clean and modern. our bed was quite comfortable and the shower was excellent. the common area on the first floor is a great spot to do some work, eat takeout, and plan your day. the hotel breakfast is very convenient. the location is reasonably good - not the best if you want a more touristy experience, but close to a lot of restaurants and right outside a MRT station, in a more authentic part of Taipei.

cons: the room was a little small. we shared a balcony with our neighbours, but neither of us were allowed to use it for privacy reasons. there was no convenient place to put our shoes or suitcase.

overall, would absolutely stay here again!

reviews.text: I visited my friends in their room and their was mold and mosquito in the room. The A/c and air quality felt very old and moldy. I could not stop coughing. The location is good but the room my friend was in was not good. It was on the 5th floor.

This was a really nice place for our visit to Taipei.
It was on the cheaper side but the room was great value.
There's free WiFi if you need it.
It's really close to the MRT and bus stops.
There's lots and lots to do in walking distance too.
Free toiletries included and the hot water was lovely, as was the bathtub!
The staff were really nice and helpful too.
The free snacks in the lobby was a nice surprise.
Would definitely stay here again!

Good if you’re on a budget, but nothing luxurious. Hotel staff were friendly and polite, good location close to MRT so easy to get around, not a bad stay by all means!

Sign in hotel saying give us a 5 star reviews for free snacks and drinks though which felt a little disingenuous.

Very nice hotel with convenient location near the TTEO and MRT just an hour away from airport and you can easily walk around some nice area of the city for shopping

Room is good (but air conditioning was so cold it made me hide under the bedsheets)

the hotel was clean and calm

Best thing here is the quality of the staff and service provided, very nice and helpful. The service provided at the counter is really impressive compared to other places I have visited in the past.

Will go again

Really nice hotel at a great convenient location. So easy to get to from the HSR station and perfect for accessing different parts of Taipei. The staff was very friendly and helpful, spoke English, and showed us where to go in Google maps. We had a beautiful large room, very private, nice bathroom, comfortable bed, refrigerator, tea kettle, slippers, everything we needed for a great stay! Highly recommended any time we're in Taipei.

reviews.text:
Good room for a cheap price. Check-in is through phone but works okay.
Clean, hot water, good pressure in shower. Bed is pretty hard but okay for me.
Not soundproof, you can hear neighboring rooms through the windows.

I was a bit worried by all the negative comments here, but in the end I figured that the room is pretty good. The room condition was something above than what you expect from its price. The reception was done over a phone call, but there was nothing inconvenient. For me, the soundproof was also fine - maybe I'm not that sensitive to noise or there was not much noise out there atm.

Clean room, modern fixtures, good price. Only drawback, no elevator. First floor was quiet most of the night but in the a.m. the sound of people dragging luggage down the stairs (ka-bump ka-bump) woke up my out-of-town guest & continued off & on thru their checkout time.

Decent room for the price, but the lack of service and appropriate behavior and policy totally destroys the quality of the remodeled rooms.

These are the reasons for my extremely low rating:
1. The 1st night was great.  Quite, remodeled decent room.
No complaints for THE 1ST NIGHT (other than it's a trek to the 3rd floor carrying luggage, and no elevator).

The issues began on night #2.
It was late and we were exhausted.  Just wanted to sleep.
Unfortunately, they or the system decided to un-program our room key.

Normally, this is an annoyance that's easily corrected with a quick trip to the front office.
But this hotel has no front office.
So we used our costly calling plan to call the hotel (while standing outside our locked door).
That's when we learned that they don't have spare keys.
Seems only the maid service people do, and they take 30 minutes to get there.

So waited and waited.  Nothing.
Called back again, and they said the key is now in the "key box" down on the 1st floor.  Nice of them to inform us of this !!!
Ok.  Down and up the 3 flights of sored stairs and yes, key works.
Finally night #2 is underway.

Day #3.
Returned in the afternoon, hoping to take a nap (since we lost sleep due to the key incident the night before), and started gaging as we climbed the stairs die to stench of peat control that was done earlier, strong enough to gag a horse.
I doubt they use substances/quantities still legal in the US.  Ive never smelled this strong of an insectaside stench in my life.

As you climbed the 3 flights, it git stronger and stronger, presumably since you were going deeper into a non ventilated area.

Entered our room, and it STUNK.
Now, 95% of the population is normal, and doesn't have my allergic reactions and irritant effects from chemicals. So for most people, its just an unpleasant odor.

But if you have any kind of allergies, or worse, asthma or respiratory issues... wow.  Be VERY wary of this place, since they don't post notice or warn you. They just bombard the building with these substances.

They assured us the odor is very temporary and will soon dissipate.
I asked for a desk fan that i can stick in the window to blow fresh air in, but as expected... nope.
So, no map. Instead headed out again.
Stayed out as long as possible.
Finally come late night, and still strong enough to gaga a horse.
Entered the room, and used one of the 2 towels to blick the stench air from the outside hall.
Opened the windows, pit the likely recirculate only ac unit on high fan, took several antihistamines, and tried to endure it.

Unfortunately, come early morning, and the noise of traffic outside and daylight coming in makes it that much tougher to sleep.

I again called down to the desk and requested 3 towels that i can try to pin to the windows to block the half that doesn't open in hopes of blocking some of the light.

They brought me 2 (better than nothing), and i finally figured a way to attach them.

Fed up and suffering, i decided to write this post, and warn people.
My advice is, if you're only staying 1 night, just check out the room 1st, and if all seems good, your fine.

But if you plan to stay more than 1 night...  beware.  I k ow i will never chance staying here again.

And they boast "sound proof rooms" in the ad.
Haha. Nothing can be further from the truth after they bomb the place with noxious smelling pestasides, and you must open all available windows.

All this is really too bad, because the rooms them self are decent.
But the management just seems clueless and ill equipped to deal with things like botching up the key programming, or the common sense to not saturate the place with such string smelling bug spray when there are guest present, etc...

DO NOT GO !!!
Very bad custumer services. I called them 20min I arrived to let them come to welcome me with the room keys and checking. But when I arrived, i called them again and they said they wont come. All checking is by phone...

First : to open the door, she said push the button and open the door. I tried 5 times no work.
I pissed of, she gave me her friend on phone, he said there is a password, then it works ! Why her idiot female friend disnt told me that !??!
I asked them to call me back because i dont want to waste 15min of my credit phone for their checking, but .... They never called me, is ME have to call them.... What a bad custumer service.

Second : they didnt find my booking data. I cant have a room for 45min until my friend call them to help me.... After an exhausted day, i just wished to checking quick but those people are no custumers friendly at all.
Room is not bad, but hot water is hard to reach, shower handle is broken (the tube felt several times), towel with holes, .... And have cockroach !

The photo is the entry building where you have to call them during 45min for the checking... A bit simple and dirty.

NEXT TIME i will search another address !

reviews.text:
The hotel is a collection of a bygone era. Opulent finishing with marble and hardwood, artwork and wallpapers, carpeted floor with chandeliers. It is a pity that the hotel is not maintained, else it would be a sight to behold. Strangely enough, these collection of a bygone era grew on me.

We immensely enjoyed the hot spring water in the room. It is the same sulfuric water you will find in the geothermal park, but watered down for our safety.

Recommended to go without expectations, and before the hotel is gone with history.

Exactly what other people said... the only good side is you have your own private bath, but I don’t think it’s hot spring water.
The room is small and cold. Not very clean. Stuff aren’t so nice.
They have free shuttle to pick you up and drop you off, but you need to reserve in advance. It’s on the hill, but it’s not too far. There are many shuttle bus that will pick up at the pick up spot, so make sure you are taking the right one. ( I accidentally took the one goes to very expensive hotel ! Oops! )

Quarantine here twice and it is a decent quarantine hotel. The food is quite good here but there will be only three meal periods that you can have the order food delivered. The communication with the desk was fine and additional requests were always guaranteed. The best thing will be the hot spring bath that I enjoyed a lot! They also accept foreign customers since there are not too many quarantine hotels accepting non-Taiwanese citizens in Beitou.

So far it's a 5 stars for th price and excellent service provided. Elevator access, spacious loft/ sitting / meeting area.

It’s pretty wicked to have hot springs right in the room. Beitou is seemly off beaten path and @foothill of mountain area. Because of the natural hot spring,  it's a popular tourist attraction.

In addition, location is about 5-10 minutes walk from Taipei Metro and going to places is very easy. Or one could request hotel transportation after 9am from and to rail station.

The room is very nice, clean, and small. The hot springs tub was excellent. Not much in the way of food nearby unless you enjoy a eh quality sushi express, Burger King, McDonalds, or KFC and even then it’s a 10 minute walk on a steep hill. No nice view at all. The accommodations are nice though, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, toothbrush, etc. included. Reception greeted us in English and a doorman took our bags. Our booking didn’t include a meal, so I can’t remark on the quality of the restaurant attached. Sweet place for a romantic stay if you’re not looking for a lot of frills or space.

reviews.text:
I stayed here for one night.
It is within walking distance of Taipei Station.
The hotel staff were polite and kind, and some of them spoke English and Japanese, which was helpful.
The room was clean and spacious.
The shower had good water pressure and the only problem was that the drainage was a little poor.
Two bottles of water are provided, but there are no amenities such as toothbrushes, so you will need to bring your own.
It was also very helpful to be able to store my luggage before and after check-in.
There are many convenience stores, massage parlours and restaurants nearby, which was convenient.
It was a nice hotel.

We stayed here the night before leaving Taiwan to return home after vacation, and it was one night too many. One star for the room because the bed was actually pretty comfortable. One star for service because the desk staff did try to help, although not happily. Three stars for location because this hotel is truly right in the middle of a cool bustling area with lots to do within walking distance; however, the flip side of that is some rooms like ours had a lot of street noise and light pollution all night long.

This was one of the filthiest and worst-kept hotel rooms we have ever stayed in (we had a room on the 3rd floor). Carpet was disgusting - stains everywhere and parts of the carpet were bunched up. Walls were dirty, marked up and had chipped paint. One couch had a weird cover thrown on the cushion area that we were afraid to sit on. A cushioned chair in the room had a large mystery stain on it that we were afraid to think too hard about. There was a random hair stuck on the bathroom wall. There was a random hair of some length in one of the beds. The caulk in the shower area was full of black mold. The hotel was apparently "full" so our only options were to move into the room next door (only marginally better) or leave and try to book a room nearby at our own inconvenience. No discounts were offered and a complex refund was possible only if we packed up and left. Because we had traveled all day and it was getting late, we decided to just stay in the room next door and try not to look too closely at anything.

This hotel also does not have any down-alternative pillows. The desk employee seemed shocked to hear that other hotels offer down-alternative pillows.

We were so grossed out by how dirty our room(s) were that we did not even consider eating breakfast at the hotel even though our reservation included breakfast vouchers. Who knows what the food prep areas look like.

If we felt any sadness about our vacation in Taiwan ending, this hotel helped get rid of any of those feelings. We could not check out of there fast enough.

The rooms are old and not maintained. At least on the 13th floor. Rooms would need a good cleaning and painting. There is also a humid smell. It does not give you a good feeling. There is a 24 hour reception. Towel and fresh water is brought every day, cleaning every 3rd day which is fine. Breakfast is okay, especially if you are asian. We caught an omelette only on our last day. We would have liked it more often. There is bread, butter and jam though. The location is the best here. Easily accessible.

Nice hotel with a great location near Ximending. On the other hand it could be very noisy throughout the traffic from the street. If you have a light sleep I would recommend a room without window. The breakfast is great and the staff very friendly.

Glad that I have made the right choice for my family. Convenient location to Ximending; just one traffic away from the busy bustle street.
Love the cosy and comfort deluxe room. Also love the beautiful hotel room corridor. Complimentary water bottles always replenish daily.
Breakfast comes with wide variety of food; not bad  Hotel lobby at lvl 13; u need to take lift up to check in. All drop off at main road that might cause some inconvenience to some travelers. So far we are alright with it.

The hotel staff are friendly and welcoming throughout our stay. They are attentive with good customer service that fulfilled to my request and needs, ensuring my stay as comfortable as possible.
Only one point to take note/ improve-unstable wifi connection.
Overall, I’m happy with the hotel services and enjoyed my stay!!

reviews.text: First time staying here, loves the room that is spacious and neat. The staff especially from the F&B department, the chamber maid that in charge of our room clean up were friendly and giving their best service. Recommended to stay if you're looking for mid range .

For about $50 USD a night, it’s not terrible. Rooms are clean and there is a small gym and laundry facility is available. There is complimentary tea and coffee in the lobby, and you get water bottles daily. No disposable toiletries in the rooms, but they are available at the front.

However, walls are thin and I can hear the adjacent rooms. Fortunately, my neighbors were only loud the first night. Gym runs a bit hot and there aren’t many machines. Washers work fine but the dryers are absolutely awful - we dried our clothes for over an hour and they were still wet. There is a 24-hour laundromat a few minutes by foot, so we went there to finish drying.

Located close to Sogo mall as well as many small shops and eateries!
Nice service! Great room and breakfast. Only the location is not that convenient. You might have to walk for 10 minutes to the downtown and also difficult to park.
Really like the breakfast here. In a good location near to all the good bars in Taichung.

Really good stay here, 2 trips.
Amazing nights sleep, very comfortable and quiet, which is difficult to find in Taiwan at a reasonable price.
Powerful hot shower, clean bathroom.
Power sockets next to the bed, which sometimes not provided in Taiwan.
Staff are excellent, one young man with glasses during the day was particularly helpful.
Good breakfast, plenty options food and drink.
Free tea and coffee 24 hours. Laundry, small gym.
Good location for bars, restaurants, 7Elevens, sogo etc.
My new hotel for Taichung! See you next month!

Hotel is clean , i love the shower , water pressure is strong ! And u can easily refill water from the water station at your floor .
Each time back to hotel also feel welcoming and relax.

Down side is -  no slipper provided, but u can buy it from hotel. Only 4 hangers provided in the room which not sufficient for 2 of us.

Stay OLAH TAICHUNG for 2 nights, staffs at reception are not warm welcomed at beginning. After I got checked in and on the way to my room, there is no card access to any floors that means all staff and guest can enter any floor. At my room I checked everywhere in my room but I can’t find a pair of slippers. OH MY GOODNESS it is understandable no toothpaste kit provided for environment sustainability but who travel with a pair of slippers?????? Later on I heard 2 girls talking at aisle way, I can definitely hear them clearly and then I can also hear cars sounds even the sounds of wheel rolling. Super hard to get sleep if you got sensitive of sounds. Next morning, I saw our receptionist cook our breakfast for us and OLAH’s breakfast only got fewer options. After that, I went out with my friends so we spent whole afternoon outside but the toilet wasn’t brushed by cleaner after I backed to my room. I need to mention that we do have night treats but only limited category of instance noodle provided and it’s self service. Over all, this hotel is NOT RECOMMENDED.

reviews.text:
Had a wonderful Valentine’s Day stay with my wife at The Lin Hotel. It’s been a long time since we went out, and this trip felt really special. We stayed in a twin-bed suite, and it was amazing! The room was spacious, beautifully designed, and had a great view with plenty of open space between buildings. The bathroom was also huge, with a separate wet and dry area, making it very comfortable.

What really stood out was the service. The staff were so warm and welcoming, treating us with kindness and care. Even though we only stayed for one night and don’t look like wealthy guests, they never made us feel any less important.

We’re so happy we chose this place—it truly felt like a sweet gift. Thank you, The Lin Hotel, for making our day so special. We were in room 1611, and we had such a great time!

This is one of the nicest hotels I've stayed at on business. Lovely rooms, spotlessly clean, plenty of amenities. The bed was very comfortable and the room very quiet. Breakfasts were excellent, and the restaurants were very good.

So far, it was the most impressive hotel I've ever been. The breakfast buffet is so large that even in my 3-day stayed couldn't taste everything. I was staying in an executive room, and they were amazing.

I stayed here for 2 weeks.
Good thing: front-desk and security is very professional, good breakfast, good location.
Bad thing: hired cleaners who cannot speak chinese, they knocked my door around 9:20 am to ask if I need service several times while I’m having meetings. It’s too early. Besides, depends on the person service variability is large. Some people doesn’t even bring my laundry bag. Another thing is loud swimming pool party at 10 pm.

The receptionists need to be trained to be more professional. The service makes me doubt that how could this be five star hotel? They can’t communicate with the good manner and can’t instruct the guests well in CN and ENG. it’s not about language skills but it’s all about service-mind. They graciously offered us the last available room, a special-access room, at a special rate. This level of flexibility and empathy exemplifies the high standards of hospitality.

I'm impressed with the consistent and genuine concern shown by your team throughout our stay. I recently stayed at Hotel Leisure Taichung and was disappointed with my experience. While the hotel's location directly opposite Taichung train station is convenient, the room's air-conditioning unit was completely ineffective. Despite the high summer temperatures (around 32°C), the room remained unbearably hot.
I requested a room change, but unfortunately, the situation did not improve. The older male staff explained that the air-conditioning system was centrally controlled and could not be adjusted individually for each room. This made for a very uncomfortable and restless night.
I would advise potential guests to carefully consider the air-conditioning situation before booking a room at this hotel, especially during warmer months.

reviews.text:
Hotel was okay location-wise. We booked the standard double room for 5 days. It was clean but you get the basics. Also, just a heads up that this room doesn't have a bidet. There are also no soap/shampoo holders inside the washroom. You also have to go downstairs if you want to request for soap, slippers, etc.

Our room only had two pillows and we had to request for extra pillows downstairs too and take it to our room.

If you want your room cleaned, you need to inform the reception area. You also have to bring your used towels downstairs so the reception staff can replace them with new ones.

One significant drawback is the poor sound insulation. The thin walls do little to block out noise from the hallways, making door slams and conversations clearly audible from inside the room. Light sleepers should take this into serious consideration.

As for the staff, most of them were okay except for one reception staff when we arrived. She was kinda low-energy and somehow giving off the vibe that she doesn't want to be there  Maybe she was just having a bad day though.

When I was about to go to sleep, I pulled back the covers and found a strand of hair on the sheets. It was definitely not mine. This clearly shows that the room was not cleaned properly. It was very unpleasant and disappointing.

I had a horrible experience in this hotel and I must share this on google, because Agoda seems to hide bad reviews.

I made two separate bookings with this hotel, one single room for 3 nights and one double room for another 3 nights. First of all, when I arrived to the hotel and my single room, it was so worn out (so please don’t believe the photos they posted online). There were hair and dirt on the floor it just looks like no one cleaned the room. The shower area has no curtain, so after shower the whole bathroom floor was wet. WiFi so weak that I can’t even check email. The walls are so thin I can hear the other room taking shower and turning the a/c on or off. At night there were this loud machine noise, I barely had any sleep so I canceled my double room stay.

Now listen,  All these are not the worst part yet. On my third day when I returned to my room at night, I found footprints on the floor! I called the front desk to see if cleaner came into my room (i did not request cleaning and the room did not seems to be tidied up), the front desk said if I did not request cleaning no one would have gone into my room. I double checked the footprints, they are definitely not mine and the prints went towards my luggage. I asked front desk to come up and check, they sent two staffs and took photos and said they will ask the morning staffs tomorrow. They relocated me to other room but I just can’t let it go like that, I was so scared so I asked them to check CCTV, later found out a male staff came into my room. And his reason was he walked into the wrong room. Luckily I was not in the room when that happened and my luggage was locked, even tho it doesn’t seem like any of my stuffs were stolen, it was still a horrible experience and I had a restless night so I request a refund and they refunded most of it.

I hope people can read this review before considering this hotel!

Good service and love the theme / style of the hotel but the rooms need updating for that price range. Equipment in the rooms is good but walls need fixing and repainting. Bathroom windows grimey and dirt / mould in various ceiling corners.

The staff we really friendly and helpful. They gave good recommendations for places to eat and visit nearby. However, you will need to exchange dirty towels and floor mats at the reception for clean ones. A little inconvenient but I think they’re trying to make guests more conscious about using supplies.

The two double-bed room itself is arranged in a weird organization. They are attached together, as seen in the photo.

Bathroom was ok. Not super clean and had bad ventilation. There is mold behind the toilet and sink which gave it a weird smell. Otherwise, the cleanliness of the room itself was acceptable.

Location was ok. It is kinda hidden in the alleyway, which made it difficult to access public transit or taxi. But the staff at reception are willing to help call taxis!

Only recommend if you’re staying few nights and spending time mostly outside.

reviews.text: Thank you for answering my request for quiet room. Had a good sleep without any noise interruption. Only have 3, maybe 4, points of improvement to bring up. 1) switches should be placed only at most 2 steps from the main entrance door, 2) lights need more independent control and zoning 3) Peephole at the door to see who is pressing the doorbell, 4) will be nice to have a bidet in the toilet. The lobbies are very clean, the strict no-smoking policy is very very appreciated (there's an outdoor smoking area). Staff are professional and courteous during our check-in/out.

Hotel lobby provides free tea and coffee for guests. The hotel cleanliness is good, the appliance is also good, as per describe in the pictures in Agoda. Morning receptionist is very responsive and friendly.

Overall, I would recommend this hotel to other guests that came to Taichung to play and visit.

The toilet of room 328 was reeking of a pungent sewage smell, the type you can smell from some drains. After requesting for a room change on the first night, we were informed that there were no other rooms available and one staff member helped us install a machine to remove the smell. But on the next day, the smell returned. Anyway, I saw other reviews mentioning a similar issue about a smelly toilet so I am not sure if it will/can be fixed, it might be a sewage pipe issue for the entire building.

On the bright side, the staff member was very apologetic and helpful when helping us remove the smell, and also offered to buy us breakfast the next day. Other than that, the balcony is not usable since it's just facing the inner alley of the opposite building and you will end up just closing the window anyway. The location of the hotel is very close to the night market which is great. But in all, it is very hard to recommend staying with that sewage smell no matter how cheap it might be.

We had a pleasant stay at JinRui Gold Hotel. It was very good value for its price. The hotel offers free coffee and milk tea in the lobby, which was so welcoming! I was most impressed with the excellent customer service that the staff and especially the manager/owner Henry provided. Henry was really a kind person!

Excellent location. Professional but not personable service.  Rooms are very dated showing heavy wear and tear, stains, chipped furniture.  Bathroom shower had mold stains deeply embedded into the grout, silicon seal.  It was likely clean but badly maintained.

8.4

- Breakfast is very good
- Room is clean & spacious
- Staff is helpful & friendly. The room next door was very noisy & we called the staff and the issue was resolved within 5 minutes

Cons:

One of my favorite hotel in Taiwan

Jan 2025 onwards, toiletries will not be provided in rooms... Carry yours

This beautiful hotel offers great service and is located right in the city center, making it easy to access nearby shopping malls, banks, restaurants, cafes, and grocery stores.
The included breakfast was plentiful with lots of choices.
The room was spacious, clean, and comfy. I particularly appreciated the strong and hot shower.
One minor suggestion for improvement would be to provide more electrical outlets in the room. With the increasing number of electronic gadgets we all carry these days, having additional sockets would be very helpful.

The location is great. The room has a view, but the interior is too old and the maintenance needs to be improved. The room looks clean but is not really clean, cleanliness also needs to be improved. The mattresses are so firm. Front desk ladies are very friendly and prompt to explain what to know about the room, even the parking lot how to access.

reviews.text:
The worst 5-star hotel I’ve ever stayed at.

1. The bedsheets were dirty, with a large reddish stain and several musty gray patches. The bathroom walls were also covered in mold.

2. The hotel's description on the booking platform was misleading.

---It indicated that access to the children's playground was included, but it failed to clearly state that additional charges would apply.
----Parking was extremely limited, so we had to park in a nearby private lot, as instructed by the hotel, which also incurred an extra fee that was not covered.
----Worst of all, we were only informed of these additional charges after making our reservation.

I loved it! Location is decent, near City Hall station. The interior is amazing for the price. My room was extremely comfortable and looks good. Even had a bathtub!

Some shortcomings: No pool or other amenities one might find in other hotels, and restaurant (breakfast at least) is quite limited in selection. However, this doesn't matter to me. Not like I would use them while I'm here. Breakfast was good despite the limited choices. A mix of Taiwanese style dishes and continental food.

Small things about the design of the room, using older key locks, lack of easily accessible power outlets make the say feel less than the number of stars on the hotel app. Overall, the stay was OK, and the convenience of the location to some personal business we needed to do made the stay worthwhile.
A bit old but still in good maintain, nice hotel, not many variaty of breakfast, but still delicious. Near family mart, chun shui tang, resto, Dr Kao shoe store.

"Dated" is definitely the best word to describe this hotel. The decor, lighting, and furniture all feels like it belongs at least two decades past. However, the service is very friendly and attentive, and overall it feels clean. The gym on the 15th floor is well equipped. The location is very convenient - only a 5 minute walk to the bus stop, and lots of good food options within walking distance.

reviews.text: Great location, about 15 minutes walk away from Yizhong Street Night Market, has a Family Mart & 7-11 nearby. There’s also a traditional market across the street with lots of food options (non halal), including early breakfast places. In my opinion, the hotel could do better in their food quality and variety, especially for breakfast spread and the pillows were also too soft for my liking. There’s also only one washing machine and one dryer, so you’ve to be lucky enough to have both not occupied. Housekeeping was clean, front desk staff are friendly and generally not much issues with the stay.

Overall good for value hotel. Clean room, good location, free parking. Breakfast was a little disappointing, and the bathroom could use a deep clean - it’s clean in general, but there is built up dirt on the shower head and taps, which should be scrubbed and cleaned periodically. Friendly and helpful staff.

The tidy space, brightness, inexpensive price of this hotel gave me so much feeling of being welcomed to this city. Also, being so close to the CMU is so convenient! BTW, the eco-friendly policy in this hotel made me want to come here again!!
When I first time came here, I really appreciated the quality of service and the room was neat. I will come back the next time I come to Taichung.

Excellent location ,Great staffs（Maggie,Cindy,Wendy )near night market and bus stops , I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a good stay .

Would definitely recommend to try staying here! The location is superb as it is only a few minutes walk away from the YiZhong Night Market, which has good food and is a great place to shop.

The host was also really accommodating, ensuring that we had a pleasant stay throughout. Whenever I needed anything, the host would reply quickly even when I asked for help at midnight, which I appreciated a lot.

For example, since they only have 1 shared washer and dryer, there was once where another occupant did not take out their clothes and left it there. I needed to wash my clothes urgently and asked the host for help. She then helped take their clothes out and store it in a bag at the side so that I can do my last minute laundry.

They also let us store our luggages in the room for a few hours after checking out without additional charges. This allowed us to kill some time without any worries before catching our afternoon train.

Overall, it is a place that is convenient, has great service and is comfortable to stay at.
I stayed here a few times over the last half a year and it has been great every time! the location is convenient and great value for the clean room and nice service.

Unfortunately, given the tight schedule, switching rooms was not a viable option.

Additionally, the hotel charges NT$50 per hour for the EV charging station, which seems relatively high. It is advisable to verify the pricing policy with the hotel or consider alternative charging options.

That said, the best feature of the hotel was the staff: we have never been made to feel so welcome at a large hotel before. We were treated as though we were important people, and the staff was always kind, professional, and willing to help us with our requests. Thank you for a wonderful stay; I highly recommend other viewers stay at this hotel.

reviews.text: The lobby is spacious yet feels oddly empty, with only two chairs available. There's limited common space for guests to relax or socialize. Probably offers one of the very best value for money in this country: a decent hotel with all the essentials.  The most impressive feature is the TV (looks like it is a 65") with an excellent selection of both local and western contents.
Automated self check-in/out is fast and efficient.
Being adjacent to State motorway 1 it is kind of in the middle of nowhere but the very reasonable room rate coupled with the low taxi fare of this country makes it readily accessible.  There is a Family Mart within one minute walk.
Noise insulation is good, no issue at all even in a room right next to the lift.
Perhaps the main drawback is the shower facility without any separation in the toilet.  Quite a typical design in residential properties in this country but not often seen in hotels.  As a consequence, the floor near the room entrance area is prone to getting wet.  Overall, it is a fine hotel and definitely well worth recommending for its room rates and overall quality.

My girlfriend had an asthma attack and couldn't sleep well. I went out early in the morning to get some fresh air and explained the smell of smoke to the service staff. I only got the reply "There is a woman staying next door, so it shouldn't be like this, right?", and then nothing happened. I don't care who lives next to me. The point is that my room smells like smoke. If it's only the next door that affects it, then try to change the room for me, right? A Disappointing Experience!!!

During my travels in Taiwan, I’ve stayed in various hotels, but my experience at Hotel Kuei was unfortunately the most unpleasant.

Unwelcoming Staff: Upon arrival, the staff were noticeably unfriendly. There was a distinct lack of hospitality, as they did not even offer guidance to find my room, a basic courtesy expected in the hospitality industry.

Misleading Room Description: The room advertised as having a king-sized bed was misleading. It was, in fact, two twin beds combined, poorly disguised under sheets. The noticeable split between the beds was uncomfortable and not what was promised.

Poor Cleanliness: The hotel’s overall cleanliness was severely lacking. The walls were visibly dirty, and the bathroom tiles appeared to have been neglected for years. This raised concerns about hygiene and potential health risks.

Bedding Quality: The bed sheets were in a dire state, marked with unidentifiable stains. This is unacceptable in any lodging establishment and significantly impacted the comfort of my stay.

Unreasonable Charges: On checkout, the receptionist charged me approximately 10 USD for supposedly damaged door keycards. These are typically inexpensive plastic cards, and the charge felt like an unwarranted attempt to extract extra money from guests.

In conclusion, my stay at Hotel Kuei was far from satisfactory. The combination of poor service, misleading room descriptions, lack of cleanliness, and unreasonable charges makes it a place I cannot recommend. Travelers seeking a pleasant stay in Taiwan should consider other options.

Another minor drawback was the absence of a wardrobe for your clothes; instead, there's a simple 3-hook clothing rack for hanging items. While it may not be ideal for more extended stays, it's functional for shorter visits. Surprisingly, the air conditioning and TV in the room worked flawlessly, ensuring a comfortable stay. Everything was great. The price is reasonable, given the spaciousness of the room, cleanliness, and convenient location.

However, one issue that upset me and my family was the behavior of the male receptionist with glasses. He had a bad temper and was rude while assisting us with the self-check-in process. At first, he didn’t even want to help when the machine malfunctioned. When we asked for assistance, he guided us in a scolding tone. Despite this, everything else about the stay was wonderful and pleasant.

I, myself extremely love every aspect of this hotel. Check in was smooth, you just had to use the counter, enter your booking details and get your receipt & room keys, and proceed to the hotel! I'm not sure why Google maps register this as a 3 star hotel, cause I think it deserves 5 stars! The lobby itself is fancy, and there's underground parking provided too, for free if you're a guest from 3pm to 12pm the day you check out. However, it's tight, especially for big cars, and the ramps is only one way, which requires skill to enter the underground parking.

Parking aside, I love the room! We got room 505, on the 5th floor [definitely not the song 505 by arctic monkeys reference]. The room itself was extremely big! Bathroom was big, and there was a huge sort of tea-time area with a small tea table. The plugs are perfect, as they support international plugs. The view is great, and they provide a lot of towels, bottled water, a seating area for you tow work, soap, toothpaste, toothbrush and all of that! Every aspect is great! You can even change the main lights to different colours, like green, orange, or even red! There's also a dining area on the 2nd floor for the breakfast area.

All is great, except the aircon panel. We can't find the way, or whether there even is a way to turn off the bright, white light coming off from the aircon panel. So we had to sleep with the extreme bright sun-like light coming from the aircon panel, which is a disappointment. To be honest, I really wanted to stay here longer, but we only stayed here for 1 night and checked in around 11.30pm.. which is sad, but I would come back to this hotel again if I could!

Returning to this hotel feels like coming home. The familiarity of the friendly staff who remembered me from previous visits made check-in a breeze. The room was as clean and comfortable as ever, providing a serene retreat amidst the hustle and bustle of the city.

One of the things I always look forward to during my stays is the delicious breakfast spread. The variety of options never fails to impress, and it's the perfect way to start the day before heading out to explore Taichung.

The hotel's location continues to be one of its biggest assets. Centrally located, it's easy to access all the attractions and amenities that Taichung has to offer, making it an ideal base for both business and leisure travelers.

Overall, my fifth visit to The Place Taichung Hotel was just as wonderful as the previous ones. reviews.text:
I lost my valuables at this hotel. They are real silver earrings and a necklace. Normally, I wouldn't have put them near the sink, but I was so tired and had an early morning tour that I forgot to store them somewhere else. When I returned to my room after the tour, the room had been cleaned, but my valuables were gone. I had a suspicion that someone had stolen them, but I couldn't prove it because I didn't have any evidence. I checked all my luggage, but I couldn't find them, so I told the hotel front desk. I exchanged emails with the hotel all day, and I decided to meet with the manager at 9 p.m. to talk about the incident. However, the manager I met at 9 p.m. was not fully aware of the situation. I had been emailing the hotel about the incident since the morning, and I didn't understand why I had to explain everything to the manager again. The manager even suspected my mother, who was staying with me, which made me very angry. I am a Korean travel blogger and have many SNS followers. The hotel did not take any action until I told them about this. I told them that I would not confirm that she was a thief, but I would leave a review on my blog, SNS, and Google to be honest about what happened.Regarding this, the hotel said that they should send me an email saying that they will not take legal action. Then, out of the blue, they said they would refund my accommodation fee. The hotel's response to the refund made me feel like the perpetrator, which made me even more upset. I ended up going to the police station and reporting the theft. They refunded me the hotel fee, but the amount was less than 1/3 of the price of the money I lost. Since they are no longer being manufactured, I can't buy the earrings and necklace again. These are the products I have been wearing the most for 10 years and because of that incident, I had to spend one day of my trip in ruins. I cried all day and felt really bad.
I can't say for sure that the housekeeper is the thief, but I think it's reasonable to suspect that only the earring and necklace were missing after the room was cleaned. In order for this hotel to be maintained, they need to retrain the staff or hire new people.

reviews.text:
Really having a difficult time choosing a rating for this hotel.
Remembering that it's a cheap hotel, I'm trying to temper my expectations.
The room was small, but comfortable,  great water pressure in the shower and best of all, the service was friendly, enthusiastic and proactive.
Only two minutes walk from the MRT, next to a mall and with food stalls across the road, the location is fully awesome.
Just a very small amount of attention to detail would turn this into a glowing 5 stars...
1. More  pillows in the room - the original set were flat, to be fair though, the staff were perfectly willing to bring us more.
2. Bigger comforter/duvet. The blanket was smaller than the bed.  I was warm enough that it wasn't required though.
3. A mattress protecter or sheet underlay would have made me feel a whole lot better.
On the whole, a good experience and i would have no qualms at all about coming back again.

The hotel is conveniently located near the train station and mall. It is good for a short stay as the breakfast menu is always the same but it is good enough. The room has good view of the train station and has sufficient amenities.

Let's start with the positive first, the location.

Just a 5 minute walk or maybe 10 with luggage.  It is next to the Tai Chung station and you can go to any part of Tai Chung from here.

No matter the north east south west you walk from the hotel, you are near the mall, the convenient stalls (FM and 7E). Every block of the building you can find at least 3 bobba milk tea shops as well as taiwanese local delicacies.

The hotel staff service is a little bit overwhelming where the lift assistant bow to me everytime I use the lift.  It is the kind of experience that extreme politeness can make people feel uneasy. I know the japanese influence in Taiwan but I only experience it in this hotel.

Next comes the opportunity for improvement.
The family room of 4 is quite small.  Especially no place for you to open up 4 pieces of luggage.

The bathroom some how have weird smell over night.  Maybe from the plumbing or something.  However when they clean the room, Its ok for the afternoon and evening.

Outside your room, the whole corridor will be filled with food odors especially in the morning when they serve breakfast at level 2 and I stay at level 10. Can you imagine?

The room sound proof is bad.  You can hear conversation while standing at the corridor.

Next come the breakfast.  If you stayore than 2 nights.  Forget about the breakfast voucher.  There is no slight changes to the menu for 4 consecutive days.  None. I know it is winter but come on, with all taiwanese cuisine on the street I believe the hotel can try to change 2 or 3 dishes easily.  Not even drinks or dessert change. And there is no fruit or salad.

Overall, I would recommend this hotel for a stay of not more than 2 nights.

We stayed for 3 nights and WILL NOT RECOMMEND.

We were an hour early and asked for early check in BUT was told to Pay instead!

We booked TWO rooms, 1st assigned room was not cleaned proper and had a strong mouldy smell.  2nd assigned room was better, room designed was outdated, things in the room was either RUSTED, STAINED or CHIPPED Off.

They had a door bell that sounds like birds chirping which if you are a solo traveller, it is creepy!!

Location is great,ie, just a few mons walk from Taichung train station. The room is clean, though looks rundown. There is only one hook in the bathroom. Breakfast was a disappointment with veg dishes and only one meat dish. Wifi is very bad - mostly poor connection with occasional bearable speed in the rooms. In addition, my family members  phone cannot connect to the  wifi in the hotel lobby.

reviews.text: Rooms were clean, good bathroom and shower and everything was fulfilling, abit compact. Definitely not luxury, but in the center of city, provided all necessities. Phoenix Hotel made out stay in Taichung a pleasant one!

The staff were friendly and helpful. We needed to buy an essential item online (for our two year old daughter) using a Taiwanese shopping app but it was not available for us to download, so we asked if the staff could do us a favour and purchase it for us. They helped to ask the seller if there was stock and if it could be delivered asap. Unfortunately due to typhoon it would not be delivered to us in time. Nevertheless, we were grateful for their willingness to help us. They continued to search online to see if we could purchase the item at any nearby department stores.

The room we booked was clean and spacious for two adults and a toddler. We were able to fit a portacot in the room for our daughter.

Our daughter loved playing in the hotels playroom! There were a variety of activities for children - dress ups and role playing, car racing, slides and climbing equipment, and a couple of arcade games. The play areas were large and spacious.

We also enjoyed the buffet breakfast every morning! There was so much food to choose from and it was all very delicious. From a variety of breads and spreads, cereals, salads, cold drinks, tea, coffee, dim Sims, Korean food, Taiwanese food, Chinese food, Japanese food, western food, and even haagen dazs icecream!

Location-wise, I think we were further away from Taichung's CBD but riding an uber to get around was very convenient.

Overall, a great hotel :)

reviews.text:
We paid about NT2000 per nite for a room for 3 adults, spacious, clean, quiet, confortable bed & pillows. Many little pleasant surprises that this hotel offers that we rarely encounter for its price. A big bathtub, a nice clean shower, and a filtered drinking water tab next to the sink.

We arrived around 12 noon, without asking, the reception let us check into our room without any early fee as the room was ready.

The breakfast menu was big, from fried noodles to porridge, some vegetable and chicken/pork dishes, toasts, sausages, salad, etc. No voucher is needed. You can have as many rounds if you like from 7am to 10am.

They serve free popcorn, ice cream with cones, herbal eggs, biscuits, coffee, and tea throughout the day at the dining hall. You can just help yourself.

Laundry and dryer service are free. You can buy a small pack of washing powder from reception at NT20 each. There are laundry baskets for your convenience, too.

Some parking at the back of the hotel and basement with the car lift. Staff at the front desk and housekeeping were very helpful and friendly too. The hotel is on a busy street. Walking distance to many eateries.

Pros:
location in the central district was very convenient. Taichung is a huge sprawling city so there will inevitably be places that will be far away to get to. But getting an Uber from and back to the hotel was very easy. Admittedly, I didn’t bother with the bus/train as it would have taken too long to get around so can’t comment on convenience of public transport.
Breakfast was good. Nice variety but it is quite similar daily. Geared for Asians though which worked fine for me.
Coffee/tea and snacks like crackers, tea eggs and ice cream are available from 4pm  which was also quite convenient and you can make use of the restaurant area to eat your takeaway meals.
The room is fairly spacious for Taiwan standards.
Wifi was fairly fast.
Water pressure in the shower is great.

Cons:
The service is not the friendliest.
The room make up is inconsistent even though we had put on the make up room light, no one came so we had rubbish bins not thrown out. When you have to put used toilet paper in the bin from 4 people, the smell does become a bit much.
Besides that, the plumbing of the toilet has a problem. Expect the smell of sewage to emit from all around the toilet bowl each time you flush which then permeates the whole bathroom and lingers in the room.
Aircon doesn’t work as it should. It’s either on or off despite being able to change the settings so i was up several times each night switching it off when too cold and back on when it got too stuffy.

Overall, for the price, because the breakfast was good, I’d say ok to stay. But I would look for a different place next time I go as I really cannot handle the sewage stink from the toilet.

Pity the very scarse nullified buffet consisting only of a couple of vegies, sweet potato and boiled egg every day... coffee and tea with toasts available but regarding food is really disappointing and the worse aspect on the hotel which is nice and well located.
Good room, comfortable bed, secretary and boiler for tea provided, mini fridge, great shower, good bathroom. Right in city cdntre, 200m from the central station with trains and MRT but 5kms away from the main station where HSR speed train stops.
The overall quality of the hotel is a bit ruined on its brkfst downgraded to irrelevance...

the room is big and nice compare to hotel at other parts of taiwan with same price range. service ok, room is cleaned everyday. location is nice, short walk from kaohsiung train station. the lack is only the breakfast. very standard and same every day. but since we always go out early everyday, we just quickly eat some mantao and egg  before we go out
Great location, only couple of hundred meters from Kaohsiung Train station. Rooms were nice and clean, well priced. Staff was also very helpful!
Excellent hotel and short distant walkable to the metro kaoshiung main station

The best thing about this hotel is the location ⭐️ the room are match with the price offering which I can't complain. So far, my experience was great. Breakfast to be note is ok, compares with other three stars hotel with no westerns food.

reviews.text:
This is one very unique hotel! The manager and her staff are warm and friendly and made me feel right at home. The artwork and decor are impressive and you can tell that a lot of care went into making this a special place. I would recommend anyone to stay here, and when I return to Kaohsiung I will certainly come here again. Keep up the good work!

I have now stayed here a couple of times, and I am truly amazed at how they continue to try and make this hotel a better customer experience. You can tell the care they are continuously putting into the place.

I also saw a very negative review by some person who obviously is mentally challenged. Please disregard this review, it has been handed over to the police , and I have personally reported this to Google on several inaccurate accounts. Hopefully this will be removed in the near future. It is unfair and wrong to intentionally try to hurt someone, or some place of business in order to serve ones ego and/or agenda.

December 2024. I just stayed here again recently (my 4th time), and they continue to grow their brand. Wow! The artwork continues to impress.

I don't understand why some person just put a negative review calling the hotel 'dirty'. Very wrong! Shame on this person! You need to report them if you can.

The hotel is immaculate...top to bottom...it's easy to see. The hotel is always busy trying to improve themselves, and something is always going on.

This hotel is alive with art and culture! Stop the negative nonsense and embrace the beauty...there is no other hotel like this anywhere in Taiwan. Thank you ArtHome...keep up the good work!

Receptionist and customer service was top notched! You can sense their sincerity right from the moment you step into the hotel.

Rooms seems to be recently furnishd and were tastefully decorated with artworks. However, washroom was not decorated at all.

We encountered twice water stoppage in the evening and the next morning during our stay.
Was brought up to an extremly high level with their staffs sincerity and warmth, but was brought back down to earth with their  basic facilities. :(

Nearby eateries plenty, and walking distance to night market.
One of the hidden gems of Kaohsiung. Feels homely yet clean. Lots of art in there as the name suggests.
Beautiful place, very well decorated and friendly service for reasonable price. Would stay again.

Creatively beautiful, every room has a unique set of art by an artist of that room.
Staff are friendly and in the moddle of City close to a night market.
