reviews.text: I had a wonderful stay at this hotel! The staff was incredibly friendly and always ready to assist with a smile. The location is perfect, making it easy to explore the area. The room was spacious, clean, and well-maintained, providing a very comfortable stay. I also loved the beautiful decorative architecture, which added a unique charm to the hotel. Highly recommend!

We spent our New Year’s Eve 2025 at Han Hsien Hotel in Kaohsiung, and it was an unforgettable experience. While the hotel is situated a bit farther from the nearest station, making transportation slightly less convenient, the quality of our stay more than made up for it.

Upon arrival, there was a delay in the check-in process, which initially left us a bit disappointed. However, the hotel staff quickly turned things around by providing us with a high-quality room that offered a stunning view of the city. Watching the New Year’s Eve fireworks from the comfort of our room was truly magical.

The hotel also went the extra mile by including additional freebies, which was a pleasant surprise. To top it off, we enjoyed a complimentary breakfast buffet, which featured a variety of delicious options to start our new year on a delightful note.

Overall, despite a few minor inconveniences, Han Hsien Hotel delivered a wonderful experience with its exceptional room quality and thoughtful service. It’s a great choice for anyone looking to celebrate special occasions in Kaohsiung!

I am not sure why other reviews like this hotel.  Reading other reviews you might think this hotel is walking distance to MRT yet distance is too far.  The rooms are showing their age and there are maintenance issues.   Our room had no outlets near bed for phone chargers.  The indoor pool and gym are actually quite good except they don't open until 9am and are not accessible by elevator.   My wife has knee problems and couldn't use these facilities because more than a full flight of stairs is required to get to 8th floor.  Overall I do not recommend this hotel.
Well above expected standards for a single person. Huge rooms. Cleanliness is top notch. Location may have been a lot far from my origin. Overall, good ambiance and service.
Clean and spacious, the view of my room was stunning. Friendly staff. A bit far from the metro but otherwise great location in Kaohsiung

reviews.text:
If I can leave a review with no star, I would.
This place sucks. We booked 2 rooms one for us and one for our friend. Both rooms' hot waters are inconsistent. The bed is rock solid and their lobby stinks like those artificial scented beads that people use in their bathroom. Our room's key card holder plate isn't even attached to the walls. One of the key cards need to be there even when you aren't otherwise you can't charge any electronics cause the power is cut off.
We hated it so much that we left this city early.

Very basic hotel. No electrical plugs near the bedside. Very dark hallways. Prostitutes outside and next door. Staff doesn't pay attention to your room reservation and gives you a lesser than ordered room. Food for breakfast was good. Would not stay here again as it doesn't feel really safe and clean. Bathroom floor is always wet from sink that seems to drain down to floor and then across floor to another drain making floor always feel wet. Calcium stains on black tile. Not good.

Good location close to Kaohsiung main station however thats about it. The single room we had was very small and dusty. Not sure when the last time they properly cleaned the place and kettle was also dirty. When asked if we could have a different kettle apparently there were none left in the entire hotel. Only reason id give it 3 stars is the concierege who worked the night shift was very helpful and tried to accomodate for us as much as he could despite being the only one working at the time.

The male staff in the evening who I guess is the owner has a very bad attitude, will wait for food to get cold to deliver it to the door. I saw other reviews to find out that it is not only my opinion.
You'll surprise that this hotel is along the narrow back lane...the hotel is nice to stay and decently comfortable, just that a lot of mosquitos in the lobby

reviews.text:
The room is very cold with Air Conditioners/Heaters not functioning properly as advertised and sitting at 19C, even after adjusting the temperature.
We were also charged the room at the price that reflected available facilities, however, upon checking-in the receptionist failed to notify us of their facilities were under maintenance, and was only updated after I took the initiative to ask.
We got a refund, only after speaking to the manager, who initially rejected the refund request.

Comfortable futon style beds in a large well designed room. Clean and presentable, with a good sized bathroom.
The only negative for me was the single small piece of soap and a small bottle of shower gell provided. There is also limited hanging space for for towels on the bathroom.
Breakfast is more than adequate.

I would usually review a hotel such as this as 4 stars - nothing exceptional. However the service I received from Reception, and especially Theresa, was truly exceptional. When we asked if she could tell us how to travel to an area of street art, she not only provided a map but also detailed instructions of how to get there on the subway system, along with a recommendation of other sights nearby. AND when we returned she took a genuine interest in the photos we had taken. All in a very friendly and helpful way. Full marks Theresa :-) You have gained your hotel a 5 star rating :-)
A little aged,  it for the price and location this was a very good stay ! Loved the swimming pool too which wasn’t crowded and was a good length for fitness swimming.

It’s a decent hotel, very close to the City Hall MRT station (Orange line). I thought even though the furniture of the hotel was a bit dated and the interior was a bit old fashioned, it offered a good value. It was a reasonable price. They offer a no-frill service.
I really liked the pool, but unfortunately it is only open on certain days and closed at 5.30pm, so basically after arrival we barely had an hour for a swim (the pool is closed the next day). It would have been great if they kept the pool open later and would have loved the opportunity for a morning swim too. You can only enter the pool with a cap, but we were given one (they don’t provide a towel, so you need to bring it from your room).

Recently I stayed in this property for two nights with family and an infant. The staff are really polite and understanding. The room is big and comfortable.
Highly recommended. I will prefer this hotel whenever I visit Kaohsiung in the near future.

5 stars as it is, compared to its price. Front staff was very helpful.  Huge toilet and shower with limited amenities. Breakfast was not the same as shown in the photos in the hotel's elevator. Great location.

Cool hotel with animal theme (you can see some fun drawings on the wall or door. We came in the stormy night, the front door was locked. The waiter welcomed us warmly and gave us complimentary noodles bowls for our dinner. Very kind!
Room is neat and clean with complimentary water,tea and coffee. I love the large bathroom. The breakfast is basic but good quality. Free Snacks and drinks in lobby area.
All in all, this is a nice place to stay when you are in Kaohsiung. Just a short walk from Formosa Boulevard MRT station.

It's a nice hotel especially for the staff's kindness and the very good buffet breakfast. They also lend bikes for free.
The rooms could be better with at least cupboards to tidy your stuff up... But most importantly the staff is really so kind.

This hotel is one of the best we been in this trip to Taiwan. Free flow of snacks 24/7, great breakfast, and very nice staff to ensure our stay is comfortable. Special compliments to the chatty breakfast staff (No.16) who took extra care of us.

reviews.text:
We were quite disappointed with our stay. The room smelled strongly of smoke. It is a non smoking hotel now but I guess the room has been smoked in for decades prior to that.
Almost all surfaces were sticky (tables, chairs and such) and there were clusters were hairs on the ground. There was also an humming sound in the room during the whole night. Probably an airco from another room.
Staff didn’t speak any English and was a bit uncomfortable having us (foreign guests) it seemed. They were nice enough anyway so no issues there.
Pro’s: the bed was clean and comfortable enough and they have free bikes for the guests.
All in all not recommended I’m afraid.
Quiet and clean, I love the ambiance. The bed is good with romantic lighting so you can relax. Breakfast is good, I love the unlimited coffee❤️

I had to ask Agoda to cancel the three-day booking altogether because of the strong odor. The first room we booked(which is non-smoking), it has a strong smoking odor but covered by a scenting spray. We asked a room change, but the new room has a strong bleach odor which caused respiratory irritation right away for me so I started to cough. When we canceled right away, their policy won’t let us cancel the first night. So I have to go through Agoda customer service, which caused us a 40-minute delay. It was a hassel.

Of the seven hotels and hostels I stayed in during my visit to Kaohsiung, this was my favourite.

While the location isn't optimal, it's a spacious and clean room with a private bath for a very good price (I stayed during a weekday). Get your own air conditioning, too.

Minor point, but there were poor hot breakfast choices. Fried rice and dishes was cold by 9am. Chicken was dried out. Only the congee was acceptable.

First impression after walking in is that the place is generally nice and it really meet expectations. Booking from internet was already printed out and stored in folder (maybe in case of computer failure maybe not but this is great impression, I know they were waiting)  now lift, clean with nice buttons on the right height. Just before lift you can rest on the sofa with a glass of complementary OJ or delicious tea (with sugar).
Time to get out of the lift ... you can see Hoover marks on the carpet along the corridor,  everything is clean. Room clean, not the biggest I have seen but not the smallest either, 1 international plug, safe to fit 15in laptop , extra pillows, relatively quiet air conditioning. Bathroom deserves a shelf and perhaps brighter light but I understand it may conflict with romantic dimmed atmosphere in the hotel.
Breakfast has average selection of Taiwanese deliciousness,  toast with jam or nutella,  porridge with a lot of extras. OJ and milk tea.

reviews.text: Highly recommend this hotel. It is an excellent location for the tram, walking along the River, and hopping on a nearby u-bike. It is very close to the pier and many restaurants and cafes. The room was clean and spacious. They also offered a complimentary happy hour. Thanks for a great stay!

we stayed this hotel 2days and it was really great bcz of stylish and clean room, kind staffs,and great convenient. and there is a man staff who can speak japanese so well.you can get free alcohol(red/white wine, plum wine) and free snack 16:00-18:00 everyday(?).
and you have to bring toothbrush and comb,if you don't, you can buy them 50 Taiwan money.
it's very cute and wonderful hotel!
Super friendly, really clean and simple but trendy decor. Great location and fun snacks!

River Trees Hotel proved to be wonderful accommodations during our first visit to Kaohsiung. Our family of four had a beautiful room with two queen beds. Everything in the room was fresh and ready.

Great location near Love River, the new performing arts center, bus lines and light rail.

When we had some challenges with payment when we first checked in, the next morning Cindy graciously approached us and said she had solved our predicament. We were ready to explore the city. Thank you Cindy for your professionalism and positive problem solving skills.

Our next visit to Kaohsiung we will be staying at River Trees Hotel.
Great room! Love the view from our room (310) of Love River. The service went out of their way to help us with payment and cleaning. We would definitely return here again!

reviews.text:
Great service from the staff always helpful and kind.
One thing I have noticed that some of the inventory in the rooms needs to be exchanged due to wear and tear. The rooms are great but needs an update of out-warned furniture. I really like to stay at this hotel for the location and service for my reasons in Kaohsiung.

An overall good stay at this hotel. Summary is as follows:-

Good
1. Service of the staff members were good. We checked in and found that rhe allocated room was at end of a corridor which I did not quite like. Requested for a change which was accomodated with no question. Although the substitued room was not renovated, it was still fine.
2. Room was large in size with separate bath and wc. Bed was comfortable and so was the pillows. Cleanliness was good.
3. Water dispenser is provided at the corridors. This hotel provides sparkling water in addition to the normal filtered water which is a plus.
4. Breakfast spread was good. They serve you specials everyday. We spent the winter solstice here and was served tang yuen.
5. The meals provided for guests at level 7 (from 6pm to 10pm) was good. They have free flow of Taiwan beer in addition to some snacks and coffee/tea. For Winter Solstice, the hotel ran a party complete with cakes, food, red wine as well as games.
6. Complimentary shuttle to the train station/airport. They provides really comfortable ride which is another plus point.
7. Self serve laundry complete with detergent. A total of 3 washers plus 4 dryers are at the guests disposal 24/7.

Not good
1. Lift is very limited. The hotel somehow attracts lots of wedding functions. This goes from morning till night. Guests to the weddings jams up the lift hence getting to the room is a real challenge.
2. Location is a tad away from everything. We were told by our driver that this is a bit off. But with the mrt, it was alright.

Great service, always greeted by the staffs when we returned hotel, cleanliness is 100%. There were a few groups checking out and boarding the cars, cabs and u could tell how efficient and helpful the staffs are to facilitate the process so tat the traffic is not blocked on the entrance. Will stay at this hotel again if we visiting Gaoxiong next time.
Room and services are great. Very disappointed with the breakfast. The place is bit dated and the food is not the best compared to other hotels.

It was a comfortable stay for us. We booked for 2 nights (Premier King Room). There is a laundromat which is what we wanted, there is a family mart closeby so we were able to get stuff that we need and is very convenient for us!

reviews.text:
Let’s be honest you can’t expect much for this price… right??
BUT it’s definitely WORTH IT:
+ very clean communal areas
+ great location
+ good kitchen and large fridge
+ other young people to connect with
+ chill and calm atmosphere
+ windows

TO BE HONEST: Yes, I have seen some mold on the ceiling BUT the negative comments are completely exaggerating it!!

It’s very little mold (only at one little spot) and
>> doesn’t affect the room, beds or air-quality.
Most of youth hostels are underground, which makes the air stuffy, moldy and disgusting...

>>>This hostel however has windows and the room >>smell fresh they also have >>balcony (communal) with a nice view, which is quite rare to find for this affordable price.

+ very comfy communal to work and eat
+ pretty clean bathrooms for being shared
+ beds are very clean
- but a bit hard to sleep on
+but you can ask for another bed sheet

Many people dislike the fact that the beds
— don’t have any curtains
which could provides privacy…. and that’s really personal thing but nobady actually cares what your doing..
Everybody is either in bed with headphones or out the room. Nobody is actually walking around, checking what your doing...

Also the walls are pretty soundproof, so if your lucky and nobody inside ur room snores then you can actually Dream Well ;)

The location was great as you are near an MRT station and lots of shops and food within walking distance.
However that were many easy fixes that could have been made that ruined my experience.
Firstly it was shown in the pictures before booking but there is absolutely no privacy in the rooms. Mixed gender rooms with no curtains and bunk beds right next to eachother. You get given key cards for the front door and your dorm but the front door is left unlocked and we noticed after leaving our dorm room locked we came back to all the rooms left open wide by the staff. It’s unacceptable as everyone’s belongings are under no security.
Secondly the wifi was out on our floor which made things very inconvenient. When bringing this up to the reception staff he stated that “the boss hasn’t fixed it”. I asked if this will be fixed soon and he just said he doesn’t know. This did not get fixed thought my 3 days here.
The drinking water also got shut off for half an hour.
The room itself was spacious but the walls were mouldy and made all clothes feel damp and smelly.
You are promised toast and jam in the morning free of charge. The toast ran out immediately and there was no jam but peanut spread or coconut paste. The coffee machine also broke and once fixed can only make a coffee every 15 minutes due to it being “too hot” as one of the staff told another guest.
The floor had about 10 or so rooms and only 2 toilets available for the females. One of them broken the entire time. The toilets never have any toilet paper and the bins are always full and cause a smell in the bathroom.
Overall it was a terrible stay which is a shame as the place seems lovely and the location is good.
Would not recommend.
Very central location. Clean and neat. Friendly and helpful staff. JoJo guided me where to go around in Kaohsiung. Will definitely recommend to friends!
The hostel isn't really as portrayed in photos. The room was fine but people working there weren't very friendly and overall not great vibe.

Nice and cozy hostel, with very clean bathrooms and a nice and spacious common area. Beds are a bit hard and no curtains but very well acclimated due to the ac in the room. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Location is super convenient, 5 min from train station, poya and 7-11. Would recommend!!

reviews.text: The hotel definitely needs a renovation but the service from the concierge was very great. The hotel is near the Kaohsiung Metro Station.

Terrible hotel. Awful service. Room smelled of stale cigarette smoke. We arrived 1 hour early, they charged us an extra 300 NTD to check in, even though the room was ready.
Bed was a very soft mattress. The 2 pillows were foam. We asked for 2 extra pillows - we were charged 100NTD per pillow. Disgusting service. Unnecessary money-grabbing in my opinion.
The breakfast was barely edible. Honestly, the worst hotel breakfast I've ever tried to eat. No western options at all.
The location of this hotel is the only redeeming quality and selling point. But there are hundreds of hotels in this area. DON'T choose this one.
It’s a nightmare experience. Tabaco and weed smell was in my room. The management attitude was terrible. It ruined my trip.
Very good service, clean room, tasty breakfast, lovely complimentary snacks and soft drinks.

Our two bedroom room was large with king sized beds. The bathroom was especially big, having two sinks and a shower, in addition to the two person jacuzzi.
The room and furnishings were in good condition, the exceptions being the two worn chairs and the musty smell we noticed upon entering the room. After that initial impression we weren't further bothered by the smell, so keeping the windows open must have cleared it out for the most part.
The air condition was quite good, a must in the Taiwan summer heat.
The view was a not too busy Kaohsiung back alley. Not too pretty, but charming with the going about of the locals. Unfortunately the day time back alley smells and night time mosquitoes meant the windows needed to be kept closed more often then we'd have preferred. Lucky the air conditioning was good!
The jacuzzi was very enjoyable, outfitted with a TV. The shower had good pressure. The beds were comfortable and also had a TV setup.
The hotel staff were friendly and helpful. The food they provided did the job, but wasn't nearly the best Taiwan has to offer.
We were doing a ten night quarantine stay with our three year old and didn't go too crazy, so that says alot by itself.

reviews.text: The room is compact, almost tight, but it's well designed and there is a decently done full bath that's finished with quality material. I would stay here again except almost no buses run on this avenue, not sure why, it's a major thoroughfare. The MRT stop is a good hike away

The hotel stands strikingly in the centre of Kaoshiung city. You can tell that it is recently built or renovated. Exterior and interior is well designed and comfortable. They have an open self serve facilities on the ground floor for free coffee/tea bad snacks. Staff are friendly, professional and are willing to help for any additional accessories you need. For a double bed room is at a competitive price, considering it is only a 5min walk from the central MRT station and 15min walk from the nearest night market.
However there is two things that prevent me from giving this place full marks. The use of "packets" for shampoo, conditioner and body wash gel. Of course this is only a minor problem considering how beautiful, modern and well maintained bathroom they have. However there is a fatal flaw in the bathroom, or I should say "wetroom"? A flimsy curtain separate the shower area from the toilet and sink. This curtain does nothing. Within minutes your entire bathroom floor wet. If they had just installed a physical barrier next to the toilet or at least stop the water from flooding (putting a wet towel on the floor will help). However this atrocious flaw is compounded by having no shelves to put any of your bathroom necessities on. If you have only the "packets" that are given, you will end up putting the spent packages on the toilet.
If it is a short stay, room cleaning will help having these flaws annoy you. But if you are one who do not like using room cleaning often or worried about privacy (rooms have no safes either) these bathroom flaws will became apparent and depending on your tolerances, can be a turn off.
It is a shame, because I ultimately enjoyed my stay here but the bathroom flaw got worse the longer you stay.

I hate my room was next to a toilet. A toilet for everyone. Really noisy. The pipe was really noisy. And soundproof not really good as you always hear people walk through. I couldn’t sleep well for that reason. Except that, everything was just fine. You got everything you need for a hotel room. Value of price I would say.

Breakfast includes a decent variety of options, and they offer ice cream and coffee all day on the second-floor lobby.

reviews.text:
The room has quite a few steps, and I've found myself tripping over them. This may not be the most accessible option for elderly guests. However, aside from that issue, I have no other complaints about the hotel. They offered amenities like washing machines, a dryer, and a 24-hour friendly front desk. The location is excellent—quiet and very well-maintained. If I return to Kaohsiung, this hotel will definitely be my top choice.

P.S.: If you or your children become ill, there’s a clinic and pharmacy nearby where you can receive treatment.

The location and the helpful staff members are the best things about this place. The lobby is by far nicer than the rest of the hotel. As a previous commenter mentioned, the rooms don't always feel the cleanest. Surfaces such as the desk and bedside tables had streaks and ring marks left behind by god knows what, and the sink also had some mysterious brown stains on the outer surface. The bathroom had a sour smell, and the overall room had a mustiness. The AC is also barely functional, as is the fridge. I also found there were some tears in the mattress bedding and found strands of hair on the bed and scattered throughout the floor. The leather-like chair also did not seem very clean, with some parts of the chair being a noticeably darker colour than others. The rooms also don't have the best soundproofing. From the hallway, you can hear if one of your neighbours is using the shower. I was also woken up by a neighbor leaving their room, and they weren't even loud - all they did was let their door fall shut.

There is also one water refilling station and a washing machine + dryer on the main floor, past the check-in counter. Both are free for guests to use, but the washer and dryer have seen better days, and you will need to source your own detergent.

The staff member that greeted us was very nice, however. She walked us through what was available at the hotel and also answered our questions with a lot of patience.

Location is close to shinkuchan, which has a pretty diverse collection of shops, including phone accessories, hair salons and tattoo parlours, and a good selection of nice little restaurants and bars.

Overall, I would not stay here again unless a lot of things changed.

The self-check in was a breeze. I was a bit worried about that because I had read complaints of that aspect of Guide hotels in Taipei. We went to drop off our luggage before our rooms were ready and luckily, there was still front staff to help us. We asked for bottles of water which they were fine with giving us.

The room was huge. There is both a standing shower with 6 interesting jets and a bathtub with its own shower head. The beds were big. The only fault I can find is the AC was a bit cranky. For the price range, I think the rooms are definitely 5-star. I have definitely stayed at hotels that are 4x the price that had worse facilities.

The location is very convenient. Lots of great cafes, restaurants nearby, close to the ShinJuKu shopping area and the MRT.

We left our luggage in the lobby again the day we departed and picked it up pretty late at night with no problem.

My partner and I are currently in Guide Hotel having our quarantine, and I must say the experience has been way better than we’ve expected. Guide Hotel is located at one of the best locations in the city with plenty of options for food deliveries and also very convenient to get to the train stations or shopping areas.

On our arrival to the hotel, we were welcome by a very lovely staff member who explained the quarantine rules in great details. Even though we have not seen any other staff yet as we are in quarantine, we have been communicating with them via Line app and they always reply in a timely manner and helpful.

Regarding the room, we must say that it is not the most up-to-date hotel but it has three windows which you can really “open” to get some fresh air as you don’t feel like are you being trapped. It has a bathtub which we use almost everyday. The room is tidy and they have supplied more than enough supplies for us to go through this quarantine period.

Overall, this has been a great experience staying at Guide Hotel with a great price. Definitely recommended!

My wife and I visited Taiwan from Canada. I was not particularly excited about doing the 3+4 quarantine. However, the Guide Hotel made it a very comfortable experience. Our room was very comfortable and stocked with everything we needed such  as water, bathroom amenities, laundry detergent, and much more. The staff were very friendly and kept the hotel running in a very organized fashion. When ordering food or requesting items the staff would deliver the items very promptly, and seemed to really care about the customers experience. I would highly recommend this hotel to anyone that is in need of quarantining in Kaohsiung.

reviews.text:
Have to change my review. Yes, the location is the best, since it’s really near the train station.

The whole building though.. it smells like cigarette. Even the rooms! Would not book here again even though the place is affordable.

They are also going to bribe you with NT$ worth of snacks just to give a 5 star review here. Now you know why. Whole building is excreting nicotine

Retracting my 5-star review – a rating that I gave just for the free ice cream. We were made to wait for more than an hour past our expected check-in time for our room to be ready. When we got there, the entire room (even the hallways) reeked of cigarettes and the floor was slippery. The only redeeming quality of this hotel is its proximity to the MRT but that alone isn’t enough to make up for the disappointing experience. Take your money somewhere else.

If you're aiming for accessibility near MRT stations, this is one of the best that you'll get. Less than 5 minutes walk and you're already in the train station! The whole room and hotel itself is decently clean, although the smell of smoke is very strong along the hallways. Not really bothersome for me but if you're sensitive on that then think again if you will book in this hotel. The staff are nice although they will ask you to give a rating of 5 stars in Google Reviews in exchange of free ice cream. Overall an okay experience! Would probably book again if ever I come back to Kaohsiung.

it a old hotel with good location, staff are friendly and customer oriented, they offer a free 100 yen if you leave a 5 star review. Reserve a room with no window and old tv system. So cant use hdmi from my tablet. Wifi speed is adequate still can watch movie. No breakfast (which only offer for Saturday stay). Well maintaned hotel but there no fridge in mine room (fifth floor). But they can help to  keep your food stuff in the cool box. Good for short stay and easy access from Formosa Boulevard exit 1. Walk to exit 4 for breakfast. Pick this hotel if u need to stay one night and get to airport. As it only subway away.

What I love about this Hotel is that it is just a minute walk to Formosa Station. The staff are very friendly. 5 minute walk to the liaohe night market.
About the room, it is spacious. We had the one with bath tub. Hot and Cold showers. You can request for room cleaning everyday. It has mini ref but the television is not a smart tv. The room is not that clean as we entered it. There are alikaboks but manageable. Wifi, is just so-so but ending we just used our pocket wifi.
Over all, I would still recommend this hotel for a long stay. We stayed for 9 days.

reviews.text:
Review for Budget Hotel

I recently stayed at an economical hotel that offered excellent value for money. The air conditioning and elevator made the stay comfortable, especially during the warm days. Its prime location, very close to a bustling street market, made it easy to find affordable and delicious meals. Additionally, the hotel is conveniently situated right on the 26 bus line, which made exploring the city a breeze.

The concierge was particularly helpful, providing clear directions to nearby eateries and attractions. They also kindly watched my luggage before check-in, allowing me to start exploring the area right away. Overall, this hotel is a great choice for budget-conscious travelers looking for convenience and comfort.
Wonderful to stay. Location is little far from railway station. But nice hotel.

Very simple easy stay. Friendly staff.
The room is a bit small but got all you need.
The only improvement would be cleaning the AC a bit more. You can see dirt in the AC. But that’s pretty common unfortunately.
I stayed at New Rise Hotel-Kaohsiung on 6/4-6/19. The room was simple and clean, and the staff was excellent. I liked all the meals that the staff purchased for me.
Comfortable bed, friendly and helpful staff, and well ventilated room at a great price. So glad I stayed here for my two-week quarantine!l

reviews.text:
I was happy during the stay.

The room was spacious and clean, facilities are new, the bed is comfy, and staffs are very friendly. There will be no water bottle, but they place water dispencer on each floor.

I booked 1 double bed room but got upgraded to a 2 double bed room with window.

Soundproof is not so good, but acceptable.

Check in after 4pm.

Not far from the train station, not difficult to walk. Along the way, there are local food, milk tea shops. The room size is just right. The rice porridge for breakfast is delicious. I like the stewed pork, the side dishes of rice porridge. The room is clean, but there are no toiletries provided. You have to bring your own or buy them.

Price-wise, it’s in the middle, which is good enough if you’re looking for tidy rooms with enough space. It’s also just a three-minute walk away from the nearest MRT station. Of course, there are several shops and eateries nearby.
Really great service at the front desk! Super friendly and they speak English for foreigners
The shower head made a lot of noisy, the toilet is not well functioned, the walls are thin, accidentally stay with noisy guests. Mosquito are in the room. Good value to stay and free parking

reviews.text:
I decided to go for a short trip gataway to kaoshiung after I ended my work trip in Manila.

However, I arrived at Kaoshiung on a busy weekend with loads of concerts and event. Therefore, most of the hotels were either sold out/ or jacked up by a few folds.

I managed to secure a room in Start Hotel for about 50usd which is stiĺl pricey. Location wise was less than 3minutes walk to the mrt.

Upon arrival, a lady attended to me and prepare a room for me. She was very friendly and easy to talk to. She lead me to my room and show me around.

There are noodles and drinks dispenser all at complimentary. I also like the toilet as facial was was also provided 👍🏻👍🏻.

Amazing Taiwan 🇹🇼

Only downside was that the wall partition are quite badly sound proof and there was this couple talking non stop till midnight and I really can't rest properly.
Convenient location, cozy, and in house free landry, level 6 lounge area provide free instant noodles, drinks and refreshments

This is overall a nice hotel to stay at.  It is very affordable and the rooms are very clean and have everything you need.  It's not fancy but I had a very restful and comfortable stay.  I really appreciated the free use of their laundry machines.  Their common room also had a lot of free food like ramen, fruit, bread and drinks etc.  The lady at the front desk isn't there a lot so you might have to call and wait for her when you first check in.

This is one of the best places I've stayed in Taiwan, thanks to the convenient access to delicious food in their cafe and the easy-to-use laundry facilities.

While the hostel-style rooms are clean and comfortable, the thin walls do allow some noise from neighboring rooms, such as coughing.

Very nice cheap(around 500 ntd per day), cozy hotel with free not only breakfast but also almost everything from noodles, coffee, drinks even beer in common room upper floor. Recommend everyone who wish cheap and nice shelter. I wish I will be here always when I will be Kaohsiung 😆😆😆

reviews.text: Stayed in a no window room when I checked in without a booking. The staff were super helpful and the tiny room was very comfortable and great value at $1500 for the night. Especially when you consider at this price it included an afternoon snack as well as breakfast. The breakfast although basic is by far one of the best one I’ve had in this range. 200% recommendation to anyone.

I'm happy with the stay and the food.
The only one thing is the toilet doesn't have a bidet or autobidet that allow me to wash after the loo/big business.
Noise when in the late night.
Small but clean room, good services, 10min walk from farmosa boulevard station, reasonable price

We were pleasantly surprised that the hotel offers breakfast and even light snacks from 3pm to 10pm daily. Coffee machine is also available in the lobby and room amenities can be self-helped in the lobby as well. Washing powder is available complimentary when you do your laundry in the basement. It's these little perks that makes our stay at River Inn exceptional - did i mention that they even provide a shiatsu massager in the room? On top of that, our room was sufficiently spacious for 2 person and every corner was perfectly clean. Every design was also well thought after. There was a day where we dropped by for breakfast late and they were about the clear the dishes. However, they informed us on that and made sure we had sufficient time to grab our food before they cleared the buffet line. They even check with us again if we needed any more coffee before they proceeded to clean the machine. Every crew on the team was conscientious and we were so impressed at their hospitable service and thoughtfulness. We had such a comfortable and delightful stay. Would love to be back again the next time we visit Kaohsiung!

Very pleasant location, near post office,bank,7 eleven(just on the corner) near the Jade Market. The staff is very attentive to your needs, thank you Amanda! She found me a box to mail some souvenirs. The room is clean,quiet, perfect. I recommend greatly this hotel without mentioning the breakfast which is a brunch!!!

reviews.text: Excellent location. Short walk from station on red line which is itself only two stops from main Kaoishiung station. Shops and alleyway markets all around. Digs easy to find. Very niche. Room is compact with the bed up a metal bar frame which you need shoes on to climb as hard on bare feet and maybe not for those who are afraid of heights. Breakfast starts at 8.30 am. The staff are very helpful.

Very cute hostel super close to the MRT station. Everyone was so friendly and helpful! The dorms are pretty small and don’t have a lot of room for people to move around if a couple people are in there. There are also not many bathrooms. However, the beds were pretty comfortable and clean. We loved the balcony on the third floor. Super cute and comfortable! Overall, a great place to stay in Kaohsiung at a great price.

- Love the place's theme & the traditional touches of the building.
- Well designed and staying true to the building heritage.
- Very helpful & accommodating couple staffs that help u with many information.
- Cleanliness was well maintained thru out the day.
- Location was great, very near to a metro station!
- A highly rated hostel that ticks almost all indeed!

I highly recommend this cute hostel. It’s conveniently located near Central Park KMRT station with lots of good shopping nearby. The staff is very helpful and friendly. Rooms and bathrooms are clean. The beds in the dorms are assigned. You also get access to 2 lockers free of charge. One is small and in the room and the other is downstairs. You are given keys to the assigned lockers with your room key. The breakfast they offer is great. It’s presented beautifully and it’s healthy.

I really like this hostel. The beds were super comfortable. We stay in the mixed dorm bedroom. The upper bunks don't have a curtain to block light in the room, but that was not a problem in our stay. Lights go out at 10 pm. And you have a personal light in your bed. The commun area is very nice, kind of like a cafe. Will defenetly stay here again.

reviews.text:
Excellent service with good environment.
I was travelling with my mum and stayed for one night at the hotel.
Originally we booked a twin bedroom, but we were upgraded to a four people’s room! The room was clean and big with good facilities, especially the smart tv.
Location was also superb as it is located near the subway station and also the night market. Will definitely stay here again if I go to Kaohsiung next time!

I stayed in 4-bed female dormitory room and it exceeded my expectations. The room was exceptionally clean, and the spacious bathroom was well-equipped with essentials, including a powerful hairdryer. There was also a universal charger conveniently located beside each bed. Overall, a fantastic experience with great attention to detail!
Our stay was great and the room was very clean and tidy. AC was perfect after a long day travelling! Thank you for making our stay amazing!

Great location - walking distance between 2 metro stations (Formosa Boulevard, and Cijin), and near Liuhe night market so you will always have something to eat every night. The staff are nice and the room is adequately comfortable. I booked a business room, so I had a nice desk and smart TV. Great bathroom, very clean and spacious. Highly recommend, and will return if I’m back in Kaohsiung!

Overall good. Conveniently located super close to Liouhe Night Market. The coffee machine on ground level was great so we didnt have to go out of the hotel for it. Also water dispenser and tea. The only thing was a bit of a con for us was it didnt include a car park as we were driving. We had to drive a few blocks around to get a parking that was not all full. There was only 1 lift so it was quite slow and packed. Other than these I quite enjoyed it.

reviews.text: Good place to stay when you came over to kaohshiung. Free drinks, ice cream, snacks and 24 hours laundry. But not recommended laundry to be done there. As many selfish and idiot guests who will occupy the whole 4 machine (Dryer/Washer) under the same room. Recommended to have a registration room number to staff before used. So guests won't misued it. Quite a disappointment for the laundry side. Room wise can be better. Space is there for big family.

Room - large, clean and spacious enough. Just as you see on the pics but maybe slightly dated but it's overall good for the price you paid.
Service - front desk is very helpful, courteous and professional. They provide free parking and breakfast. Must say the breakfast service is really good and they offer all day coffee & tea & ice cream in the restaurant area.
Location - this is great for someone who enjoys my walks. 2 department stores within my walking distance. Street market, restaurants and central park are all close by. Really enjoyed my stay.

It's one of the smaller Kindness Hotels, located about 10 minutes walk from the KRT station Central Park. The area is popular with Japanese and Korean tourists.
Everything is pretty old already and might need some renovation, but everything is very clean and the bed is comfortable.
I recommend the Deluxe room which features sliding doors separating entrance area and bedroom. Without them you would hear every noise from the corridor (they don't close fully though because they're not completely straight anymore, so you'll still get some noise).
The room is spacious and even features a drinking water, so you can always refill your empty bottles.
Breakfast is much more limited than in other Kindness hotels. They usually provide one vegetarian dish, one meat dish, rice, congee, a very basic salad buffet, boiled egg and for western choice white bread and jam. If I remember correctly, they had a few more options before the pandemic. The live cooking station is gone unfortunately and at least some fresh fruit would be nice.
During the day you can always get free drinks, ice cream and some basic snacks.
The late night supper isn't offered anymore. In the past it was very basic already, so for me it's not a big loss.
Free laundry is still available while the free bicycle rental seems to be gone.
The very friendly staff is for me the main reason to come back here. They're always friendly and make you feel welcome.
Overall, it's okay for a price of NT$1200-1500 for the Deluxe room, just don't expect too much.

Basically the service in this hotel overall is good enough. Especially the front desk, they are really lovely and helpful. General speaking, the F&B service was lovely too, only the last day which is 25/02/2019, the chef who was doing onshore cooking service, his attitude was a little bit cranky, after the customer had a chat with him, he started changing his cranky face.
Overall, I still recommend people if you want to stay in the hotel, This is a good branch.

One of the best hotels I’ve ever stayed in! Although not luxurious, everything about the hotel was perfectly thought through and designed for the user experience.
Located conveniently abiT off the main busy stretch but walking distance to lots of food and bars, a little longer walk and you would get into the main busy shopping stretch. The hotel was super thoughtful in the service and amenities they provided. There was 24hrs free coffee, tea and ice cream which was self service, a laundry room with free use of their washing machines and dryers - the staff would even help you to dry your stuff when the machine is done washing! There was a 24 hour reception which is manned by really polite and kind staff who are always there to answer your questions even at 1am!
The room was well designed with all the amenities provided, from hair shampoo, conditioners, bath wash, moisturisers and even facial wash!
The rooms are super clean and there was an in-room tap with reverse osmosis water for you to refill your water and boil tea with!
The best part, the room also came with free breakfast which was pretty sumptuous for a simple hotel. The buffet spread of stir fried dishes, rice, porridge, soup (oh my god so good!) cereals, salads, coffee, teas and juices.
The service was also really good. Unobtrusive and always polite. They are really efficient and nice.
I would def stay here again if I come by!

Big rooms with jacuzzi

reviews.text: Good location but unfortunately that's the only positive. The motel doesn't enforce it's non-smoking policy very well so the first room provided was unbearable. Thankfully, the staff changed the room without too much quibble. Unfortunately, the staff phoned at around 3am asking to vacate the room due to confusing our room with one of the hourly guests. No apology given.

We chose to stay here because we had a decent experience at the Kiwi hotel near Taichung train station. However, our experience here was a significant let down compared to the hotel in Taichung. The rooms were dated, the beds were uncomfortable, and the breakfast they provided was subpar. If I'm back in Kaohsiung again in the future I'd be looking to stay elsewhere.

There is no parking, and it is very hard to find street parking in that area or you need to go to an automatic parking that charges 100ntd per hour.
There was musty smell in the bedroom, I think someone smoked in it before and they just don't care and gave us the room smelling like that. Not super clean.
Ok for a night, convenient location, but wouldn't go back.

The shower had barely any water pressure, the hand towels were poor, there wasn’t any hand soap. The water tap was very inconsistent with the temperature. Could not enjoy a shower. The bed was very soft my grand mother could not handle although I could tolerate it ( reason for two stars ). The paint needs repainting. However, it is a subpar room and if you can tolerate poor water pressure, and you don’t mind looking at the horrible paint then it’s for you. Would not recommend if you are looking for a comfortable place to rest.

Side note : it was very close to the night market so that helped

Hope this helps anyone who is visiting here
Excellent location near Kaohsiung Station and the local Jilin St Night Market. Amenities included comfy light slippers. Great value for money. Highly recommended!

reviews.text: The 5 star reviews are fake, they offer free coffee and ice cream when you leave a 5 star review. This is a very basic but relatively clean 3 star hotel. The staff were friendly and spoke English and the room had the basic amenities. The AC leaked water into the room and hallways, the walls were really thin, and there was a strong smell of smoking in the room. Good for a cheap short stay in Kaohsiung but definitely not 5 stars and wouldn’t want to stay there more than 1 or 2 nights.

The room is small, reeks of a mixture of tobacco and mold that I can not sleep at night because of this. Encountered a cockroach on the bathroom floor. Interior looked nothing like the photo I’ve seen on booking site. The door lock doesn’t seem to provide any level of security, and I can hear people coughing next door. I have not a single clue as why this hotel has such a high rating other than the fact I noticed there is a tiny sign promised to provide some kind of free service if rate a five star on booking site. The staffs seemed nice but that’s about it.

Pros:
- The location is close to Kaohsiung Arena
- There are convenience stores, food stalls and restaurants nearby
- The employees are friendly

Cons:
- The entire building is very old and lacks maintenance
- The room we stayed in was very moldy; almost all corners of the ceiling are covered in molds
- The floor was dirty and dusty
- The slippers in the room have very obviously been used before and not cleaned
- There is no ventilation at all in the bathroom so the entire bathroom was wet for the entire 2 nights we stayed there. This, in-turn, caused the whole room to be extremely humid
- The window was broken so we couldn't even open it to get fresh air in
- There is no remote control for the air conditioner so it's either ON or OFF
- The lock on the door is literally just a knob and a rusty old chain; not very safe for women traveling alone

Conclusion:
This hotel is okay for last-minute emergency short stays but if you want a comfortable place to relax, this is not it.

P.S. They entice guests to leave 5-star reviews for free coffee and ice cream so keep that in mind when reading through other reviews

Fake 5 star reviews I would say this hotel really deserves closer to a 3 star rating. Rooms smell like tobacco and the air in the rooms is very humid leading to what looks like mold problems.
Shower also has no shower curtain.
Doors shutting are also very loud.
I would say spend the extra money to sleep somewhere else.

I love the location so close to Zouying exit 2. It has hospitals, near bank and 7eleven. The room was unexpectedly big. It even has bathtubs and hot and cold shower plus the shampoo smells really nice.

reviews.text:
What a comfortable hotel to stay at in Kaohsiung! We only needed it for one night, but the hotel is comfortable enough for an extended stay as well. The hotel lobby is located on the 11th floor of the building, which seemed unusual at first, but it felt completely safe. Our room was spacious and offered a great view of the city, even from the bathroom. The soundproofing was decent, which was important for me as a light sleeper.

The amenities included complimentary ice cream, snacks, tea, and water. There was a small conference room set up as a fitness center, but we didn’t have time to use it. The complimentary breakfast buffet offered a variety of delicious options, including hot items, salad, and congee. Overall, it was a great value for our stay!

It is also located along the red line MRT, which easily connects you go the airport or the HSR!

The hotel’s room really spacious and located convenient - few mins walk to train station, 7-11 and supermarkets. But can hear the noice from next rooms.
Good service n worth for the price. Recommended!

On this month-long trip to Asia, I have been fortunate to stay at five 5* hotels. While Hub Hotel isn't in this category, the beautiful room took me by surprise and easily became my second favorite hotel of this entire trip!

For its price, the room (I sprang for the Exquisite room) is spacious, well-designed with plenty of natural lighting (I got lucky with a corner unit facing the funky, cool shaped Kaohsiung Port Cruise Terminal), has a washlet! and I LOVE the restroom and shower tiles, was equipped with a 55" Google TV and its preloaded movies, casting capabilities and general TV that made for great entertainment, while the location is stellar (only a 3 mins walk from the R8 station -- take exit 1... don't listen to Google Maps' instruction 😅) and can't go wrong with included breakfast + 24h snax in the lobby and wonderful service from the entire staff. It made working from this hotel for the past five days so delightful.

The only downside is that Hub Hotel is on the 11th floor of a building that is shared with 5 other "hotels" on other floors and businesses so the elevator is almost always in use, though there are 5 lifts that move quickly.

Will even consider other Hub Hotel locations when I'm back in Taiwan next year!

Heyyyy :3 Thank u so much for my wonderful stay! I stayed in the Hub Hotel for 3 days and it was amazing. I was specifically looking for a hotel where I can rest and enjoy holidays and the hub hotel was the best choice ❣️🥰❣️ I love the big choice of delicious breakfast and the cute mini gym with the massage chair! I could stay there the whole day :D and there is free ice cream!!!!!! Uhhhhh thank u so much for the most comfortable bed, I had the best sleep and I loved my room💕 thank u dear staff and dear hub hotel. I can only recommend it with 5 🌟. ❤️❤️❤️

reviews.text:
Good facilities; good quality free bikes, water dispensers, elevator, flyers and maps, free breakfast with coffee (black or latte).

Comfy rooms; very bright and nice rooms! Windows. Not too small, perfect size! Good beds. Good shower although the drainage was a bit smelly 😁.

Breakfast is one set per person, it's either Chinese or Western (I saw reviews of other people who got Vegetarian as a third choice but they didn't offer us). Chinese breakfast consists of rice porridge and some cooked veggies and fish. Western breakfast is less healthy with deep fried goods, some fruit and a filling sandwich. I would recommend the hotel to decrease the deep fried goods for breakfast, perhaps swap it for a bit of salad with a cooked egg or something :)! Coffee is good though, black and latte are both 👌.

Staff was very polite, but I wish they'd be warmer and smile more, like all Taiwanese do!! When we went, I felt the staff was a bit cold or shy. 就是人員很客氣服務很好但是我希望他們會比較熱情一點，多笑一笑 😁，像一般的台灣人很會！！ 我們住這裡的時候剛好人員保持距離，可能他們害羞還是什麼，但讓我感覺他們有點冷漠。

Overall an excellent value for your stay in Kaohsiung!

The place was very spacious and clean, decorated with bikes and wheels as a theme.  There are 3 choices for breakfast (Chinese, Western, or Vegetarian). We tried the Western and Vegetarian options and both were delicious with generous portions. We also borrowed their bicycles for free to see the Love River and the nearby Night Market. Overall, it was an excellent experience and I would highly recommend!

Clean, complete amenities, good space, happy dog, friendly staff, good breakfast, free parking... all that for a super cheap price! Deserves 5 stars.

reviews.text: When we arrived, a nasty smell greeted us. Upon arriving to our room, the bathroom is slippery, bedsheets weren't changed on one bed, the floor looked like it wasn't swept in years, the electric fan is very dusty, the room given to us had chipping paint off the wall by the window, the window is dusty too, beds had hard mattresses. The location is okay as it is near the train station. However, the outside of the hotel seemed suspicious to me when I looked it up on Google Maps. I hope that the owner of this building would consider properly renovating the place. I don't recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Taiwan in the Kaohsiung area. Book a hotel that goes for quality not quantity.

This hotel has been falling apart, possibly for the past three decades. It is not the staff’s fault, as they are polite and as accommodating as possible.
My partner and I were given a room that had a hole in the ceiling, cigarette burns in the sheets, urine stains on the bed, crusty yellow pillows, bedbugs, and cockroaches. We left almost immediately after seeing the room. The room also had an old electric fan and the blades were covered in dust and grime. The staff offered us a different room, but after seeing cockroaches and bedbug droppings, we didn’t feel comfortable trying a different room. We booked this hotel because there was a note that it had been recently renovated, but that is not the truth at all.
It is okay for a property to be old, but it is unacceptable to expect people to pay to stay in unhygienic conditions. Whichever greedy landlord who is prioritizing profit over customer service is digging themselves out of business.

Location is amazing. Basically across the road from the main Kaohsuing Train Station. Has a 7-Eleven across the street on two different sides of the building. Staff were very friendly.

The only thing modern about the property is the name and the prices. Everything else is from the 1950s or 60s, even the staff. TV from 2010 without HDMI. They could certainly spend a little money to upgrade the rooms.

reviews.text: I loved it. February 2024. I paid 2000 NT for two nights, the idea is good, having to tap everywhere is kind of a bothersome and also, during the day the shops clients are a little bit too close to the hostel... However, I'm trying to book now march 2025 and the price is more than double 😱 kind of a shame.

You need a key to take a piss. You have  to swipe your card in and out. Annoying. And it's quite loud during the day as you are literally living in a mall. Most of the toilets are closed at night?????????????? Only one entrance to the establishment late night. Intricate door lock system to follow. The jazz music they play nonstop is awful no offense.

The best location in Kaohsiung! You can sleep right at Pier 2. Check-in is automated, but we had assistance from the helpful staff member (it may be more tricky if you arrive very late). The gates to exit/enter are troublesome at first. You must push the gates slightly before pulling them open (then it becomes easy). This is a concept hostel in partnership with Muji. I stayed Fri night. I am only surprised that the place is not full of people. Occupancy is low for some reason.

The check in process is a bit of a nuisance. They insist on you using a kiosk, but a person needs to help you do every step which seems superfluous. At night when people are trying to do self check in using the kiosk it is super annoying as the automated voice keeps talking and it disturbs those in the cabins near the kiosk. People trying to check in ended up having to make a phone call. There is a room full of showers and sinks which is clean and only accessible to the hostel guests, however the toilets are accessible to the public, and they aren't as clean or private. Lastly the security gates to and from the hostel private area are difficult to open and close so they were often left ajar, therefore making things less secure. During the day I saw tourists wanting to check out the hostel cabins so security could be a bit at risk. The cabins/rooms were quite nice and comfortable, very simple and seemed clean. Don't bet on being able to sleep in past ten AM because that's when the mall just below the hostel (hostel is on a loft) opens and there's quite a bit of noise. Location wise it is awesome and you have access to tons of food, sites, and conveniences. The rooms all have AC units. Because they are small, you may not be able to keep your luggage open inside the room. The rooms unfortunately do not have many hooks, there were only two in our room which is not enough.

reviews.text:
The receptionist wasn't friendly and didn't speak English. I arrived at 2:45 pm, and she informed me that check-in was at 4 pm. I waited in the resting area, but there was no WiFi in that corner.

Two other couples arrived after me and received their rooms before mine. I waited for 45 minutes, and the room was still not ready. I waited until 3:50 pm when she finally gave me the room key.

I had booked a double room but received a Quadruple Room, which left half of the room space unusable. The bathroom had a bathtub but no curtain, causing the entire bathroom to get wet after a shower. The towels were old and torn. I was surprised that they provided such towels to customers.

The only positive aspect was the location, as it was very close to the BTS Formosa Boulevard Station. However, there were very long stairways to Exit 11 for the hotel. With a big suitcase, I had to use the lift at Exit 9, which required an additional 100 meters of walking.

Before checking in, I received a message from the hotel asking for a 10/10 review, which I found inappropriate. After this experience, I cannot give them a 10/10 rating. They would only deserve a 2 stars.

Cozy and comfy stay near the Liou He Night Market.

We enjoyed two days and two nights of staycation and food here.

Will come back again in the future.
Really good value hotel and good service. Rooms are spacious.

Traveling with my family, including two young children, and we woke up on the second day to the heavy smell of someone smoking. Totally unacceptable.

If you keep your expectations low, this might have been okay. Not the cleanest, no features worth speaking of, but the lack of enforcement on the no smoking policy is a dealbreaker for sure. When we raised the issue with the front desk, the attendant came in and said he didn't smell any smoke and gave us the runaround. "No smoking" sign has no meaning here.

This hotel has no-smoking signs displayed everywhere inside the hotel. If someone was smoking in their room, Smell of smoke was so bad and you will not be able to stand for it. The hotel service personnel will just open the alley door and use a big fan to blow it.

The customer service, which was once a highlight, was shockingly rude and dismissive.

Fantastic value for money! The bed was comfortable, and the room was very clean with great access to public transportation. The breakfast was also good. reviews.text:
Full bathroom the best in Taiwan.
Room could be better but it has what is needed, except for a kettle inside the room.
The building is a bit old and not in a good shape but the owner keeps the hotel clean, very clean. Towels' service is excellent, very clean and a nice laundry detergent. Kitchen is available for use of guest, microwave/toasted oven which is very convenient. Snacks, coffee/tea in the  common area, near the kitchen are always available. The hotel area is a one open floor plan which makes it feel guests like one family;  On the other hand, privacy areas besides the room are non existing; however, the owners keep professional boundaries between guests, and their private life and that helps the fact that there are not place to step out of your room because there is non. The owner speaks English and he is very helpful when possible. He keeps rules for payments and check-in or out but he is flexible when necessary to accomodate travelers different and unique needs.

Located at very convinent location. 4 min walk from MRT Station. Down there is a 7/11. 5 min to Lihue Night Market. I stay here for 14 months. Is like my home. There are free snacks (sweets, biscuts) and instant coffee plus tea bags. The owners are very friendly and helpful.

for what it was it was okay. we found little small bugs in our room and our beds, but we just killed them quickly. the AC blew relatively cold which was appreciated. there was free laundry service, though they returned our clothes later than they predicted. clean spaces, though the shower area was pretty cramped for someone my height (6 ft). wife was fine at 5'2. being close to a station really helped to move our luggage, and busses were actually super convenient.
Family run hotel. Good location and the room is very clean. Amazing value for its quality. Plus the host is very friendly.

Very cozy, homely accomodation on the 10th floor of an apartment building. Very friendly welcome and orientation. All you need provided: water dispenser, WiFi, kettle, fridge, adapters etc. Very near the food night street market. Also easy walk to the Formosa Boulevard MRT. A few blocks away is a large supermarket. Only problem is a very small sign with hotel name so entrance not  easy to see from the street  Enjoyed our two night stay.

reviews.text: Straight forward, no frills hotel. Clean and nice to stay at. Fairly close to the pier and the main Formosa station. Right next to a convenience store and near some of the city bike stations. Has a mini fridge and free snacks. Big and comfy bed. Clean bathroom. Stayed 3 nights. Glad with my choice to stay here. Would definitely try it again.

Bring ear plugs. Bring an eye mask. You’ll sleep better. The room is cramped but comfortable. The water pressure is strong. The WiFi is excellent. The problem is there is no insulation for the sound of other guests coming and going. The room doors essentially slam shut. The cleaning staff in the morning are also unintentionally noisy (carts and plastic wrappers). Unless you expect to be up by 6:30/7:00 in the morning, bring ear plugs.
Bring an eye mask as even my “windowless” room had a bathroom window with a curtain that wasn’t sufficiently dark, and the lights from various electronic devices in the room such as TV and WiFi created enough light to see well by once my eyes adjusted.
On the plus side, the staff was very friendly and helpful. The amenities were also excellent. It was not a bad place to stay, very basic but comfortable enough. That said: ear plugs and eye masks are a must for a good night sleep.

Room is consider clean but not new.
Public transport is not near.
There’s a 7-11 beside which is very convenient.
Overall is a good deal if you are looking for something cheap

Now that I'm out of the town, I can write an honest review:

Even with relatively central location, public transport not very close.
Room was clean but the basic double room i stayed in, had only one free power socket visible, and that one didnt work either. I found one free socket behind the fridge and that one gave me a small electric shock, but I still had to use it.
Check out time is 11.00, and I asked late check out until 15.00 but it wasn't possible. The only option was that I had to give the hotel 5 stars on Google Maps (they checked) and then pay 150TWD to have my room until 13.00.
The daytime lady was very helpful and kind even though she didnt speak good english. The staff in general was nice.
7-Eleven literally next door.
I would recommend for a budget traveler.
Good for the price. The room was clean and comfy. The staff were nice and helpful. A decent place if you just need somewhere to stay.

reviews.text: Good👍
Good

Every time I go home, I look forward to staying there because it’s the closest to home and you can ride a bicycle for free.
This time I stayed at Marshmallow, which has a spacious bathroom with wet and dry separation. It totally surprised and delighted me! For me, the CP value is higher👍
The room is also very big and there is a small refrigerator for ice!
I’m also very satisfied with the clothes hanger. The highlight is that there are sockets on both sides of the bed, which is really convenient for us who can’t live without 3C and often need to charge!

On 9/30, I told the B&B operator that 10/3 of my stay would need to be canceled due to the typhoon. The operator said that I would need to announce the suspension of classes and classes before I could cancel in full for free (I didn’t know at this time that the rules for full payment were different).

On 10/1, I once again told the hotelier that Kaohsiung has issued a notice. Can I cancel? The hotelier said that I would check in on the same day. However, the last typhoon caused serious flooding in Kaohsiung, but there were no suspensions of classes! What to do then? Moreover, the northeast monsoon is coming from the north...
I called the Consumer Protection Association to ask, and they said that if I paid in full, I could get a full refund if I gave notice of cancellation three days beforehand. Then the B&B proudly said that it would help me cancel, but did I get a refund by swiping my card? Not only did you not respond, but you blocked me? ! Is this the intention of Huangpu New Village to provide housing instead of nursing care? I was originally going to travel and encountered a typhoon, which was already very disappointing. But I also encountered this kind of B&B that seemed to have good timing but terrible attitude. It was really terrible🥲

CP value is good!
But the disadvantage of room A is that there are many mosquitoes!
It’s not a door or window problem! The mosquitoes are coming out of the bathroom drain hole!

reviews.text:
I’m guessing this hotel has seen far better days. Both receptionists we encountered were rude and impatient. I was taken aback to witness someone treat my mother with such disrespect, especially because Taiwanese hospitality is legendary, and culturally, Taiwanese are respectful toward elders.  It really felt as though we were imposing on them during check-in (came early to drop off luggage).

I suppose I can deal with snooty staff, maybe chalk it up to a stressful week for them both, but the rooms were mediocre and dingy too. The toilet wouldn’t stop running unless the handle was jiggled in just the right way. I had been looking forward to using the jacuzzi/bath, but it’s evident the tub hasn’t been properly cleaned in some time.   The hotel is in great need of a refresh/new management. How on earth are the ratings even this high?

**edit: I’m raising the rating to 3 stars because the manager tracked down my mom and apologized profusely to her. I think there is clear room for improvement, but I appreciate the manager’s willingness to try and make amends.**

Medium-sized hotel for business and tourists. Interior feels rather modern and quite well kept. Location is about 10~15 walk from the nearest metro stations, but the hotel does have a parking lot, so driving here is no problem. Breakfast  contains small selection of of continental and Chinese dishes, and surprisingly can be rather filling. Service here is friendly and attentive, and I believe English is ok.

The location is convenient. MRT station pretty nearby... within walking distance. The service staff were very friendly and helpful to provide all the necessary information.

The only thing about it is that - the managing 'style' is very 'old school'... You need to drop your room key at the reception everytime you go out... No sneaking out... LOL Because they will 'catch' at the reception before you step out and ask you for the key. LOL

The room was huge and spacious. Though it said it's a non-smoking room, I can still smell the lingering of tobacco... That's not very nice.

Price is okay for the last minute selection.
But the room has a bit of smell and the decor is super outdated and the furnitures are worn

Comes with mosquitoes when you open the door.
Bathtub like cleaned last week or so.

But staff were friendly and nice. But probably won’t come back for that.

As for the cleanliness of the room, it needs to be improved. Several parts are dirty, which is a pity for such an elegant and comfortable decoration!

To sum up, it is very noisy. It is recommended that you play until you are exhausted before coming back to sleep... There is a lot of excitement downstairs every night, and it is even noisier on holidays. The accommodation experience is acceptable.

語重心長的說吧

人員服務很好，有額外提供小餅乾跟瓶裝水，打掃的也算乾淨，房間裝潢也蠻新的

The new decoration feels very good, the environment is comfortable, you can temporarily store your luggage, and there are counter staff. However, the floor is downstairs of the hotel. There will be the sound of high heels and KTV singing in the middle of the night. Light sleepers need to wear earplugs. The sound will not stop until about 4 o'clock.
When flushing the toilet, you need to close the drain hole of the sink, otherwise the smell will be discharged!
The hair dryer is fixed on the wall, which is not very easy to use. The shower gel is slippery. For those who are very concerned about this, it is better to bring your own. There is a lot of storage space, the room is large, and the price is quite reasonable. There is no parking space for motorcycles. You need to park in the surrounding parks.
The bathroom is separated from wet and dry, there are no small towels, they are disposable ones

228. I booked a room too last minute for my vacation and thought I wouldn’t be able to book it. Fortunately, I called to ask how many rooms were left🥹
The room is clean and tidy, you can choose movies to watch on the TV, and the bed is hard so it's easy to sleep hahaha! The noise was not as exaggerated as expected because we were staying in a room with windows, so I personally felt that the sound from outside would not affect our stay.
There are a lot of places to eat nearby, and it’s only 10 minutes away from Liuhe Night Market~
It's just that parking is not convenient. You may have to find a parking space on the roadside or park in the parking lot of the park, but it is really expensive to stay there all night QQ

Hotel located next to the MRT exit which is very convenient for travelers. The building why it is located may be a bit sketchy but once you are in, it’s another world. Would recommend to anyone.

Stayed in one of the private double rooms and was very comfortable. Great beds, good showers and lovely view over the park from 12th floor. May need ear plugs if a light sleeper and traffic is busy, but flawless other than that

Dorm, bathroom, common areas were all extremely clean and well maintained. Staff is friendly and helpful my bags that I had left early in the morning were even brought to my dorm and placed into my locker when I returned later to check in. Sheets are clean. The slippers they have you change in to are scrubbed with soap and water.

Location:
Strategic location, just right infront of MRT station (walking distance only 15 second from MRT exit, yes you see it correctly 15 second not 15 minute)!!

Room & Service:

Strongly recommended for all travelers. I will go back to Kaoshiung and definitely stay with Jezreel Inn for my next visit.

reviews.text:
PROs
• 24 hours snack bar : steamed bun pork is separated into another steam machine. Coffee machine and 3-in-1 coffee sachets, milk tea sachets, various tea bags. Biscuitts, popcorn, various ice creams flavor, four juices options

• my booking came with Free breakfast. As a muslim, the staffs helped me decipher which one is vegetarian.

• spacious, clean and very inviting eating area. Really nice to hangout here while waiting for laundry etc

• cloth iron : i went to a few more proper hotels in taiwan, they don’t even have iron. So i was really glad that Royal Group Hotel does.

• Bidet: spacious bathroom with bidet. Even toilet slipper is provided. No bath tub. Soap and shampoo provided

• Free laundry: out of 5 hotels i stayed in my 10-days trip in taiwan, this is the only one that provided FREE LAUNDRY WITH DRYER. detergent included, proper laundry bag too (not the plastic kind)

• Safety box in the room

• Refrigerator and kettle in room

• 4 water bottles (most hotels only gave 2)

• Location: near the main station. Easy walk.

Rooms are clean, size is ok. Staff is friendly, breakfast is good. Location is ok as the MRT station is 5 minutes away and the bus station 2 minutes away. There are enough restaurants nearby and there is a 7/11 around the corner.

Nice and clean hotel conveniently located near Kaohsiung main station. Breakfast was provided, and it was very good all you can eat Asian breakfast with noodles, stir fry vegetables, eggs, hash browns, soy milk, bread, cereal and many more.

The layout of the hotel was a little narrow due to the nature of being located within an old building, but the Royal group made the most out of it. The toilets tend to be wet as they do not have a shower curtain.

I liked that the rooms are cleaned on a request basis to be more eco-friendly.

The staff are very helpful to our needs. They helped us to book a taxi to nearby attractions and advised us on transport.

This hotel is in a good location for getting around town -- near the Kaohsiung main station and a big bus stop with lots of bus lines -- but the surrounding area is a bit sketchy. The immediate neighborhood is rundown with homeless people sleeping on the sidewalk. The room was a good size but had the feint smell of stale cigarette smoke. The bathroom had a somewhat stinky smell at times. Lots of complimentary toiletries were provided. The 24hr snacks are a nice touch as is the free laundry (2 washers/2 dryers). There is a nice big dining/hang out area on ground floor. Breakfast was included and it was a great value with lots of variety. Recommended for the cost and location.
Buffet breakfast is great and all day popcorn cookies ice cream coffee and juice is just unbeatable 👍

reviews.text: This is a very nice hotel. I enjoyed my stay very much. The location is perfect, it is directly opposite of the famous Hanshin Department store and very close to the beautiful Pier 2 and Love river, also, the Metro to the airport is a five minutes footwalk away. I love in particular the nice ladies of the reception, they are kind, helpful and friendly. My room was large and had a bright and positive atmosphere. When I come back to Kaohsiung I will choose this hotel again. It added to the happy memory of my stay in Kaohsiung.

Overall, I was very pleased to have stayed here. 3 stars probably seems a bit harsh considering I have no complaints as such, but I guess my rating reflects a lack of any extras or surprises. Perhaps that’s exactly what some visitors want, but I’m always hoping that something will blow me away just a little - whether it’s the room, the staff or the breakfast buffet. All were absolutely fine, but no more. The room was nice enough and shaving cream was the only amenity that I wished they had stocked. The staff were mostly cheerful, but very direct. No chit chat, no asking if everything had been fine during my stay. The check out and in experience was almost too quick. I handed over my key and asked to check out and they said “see you”. The breakfast buffet was on the small side and I tried most of it. That was all okay, but I only one or two items had a sign to tell people what they were. I would have liked that.

Overall we have a great stayed in the hotel, and the service was excellent. Location will be very convenient to convenient store,food street or bar street. Beside that, it just located right beside a shopping mall.

The only thing I don't like for this hotel will be the condition, abit old for all the facilities,is time to upgrade.
The kindness of the staff is really good they supported all my requests. The problem is that it's really hard to find someone that speaks English, only 2 of them. Rooms are pretty clean
Overall the room was good. Spacious. Accessible to shops around the vicinity. However there were too many mosquitoes in the room.
