reviews.text:
Hub Hotel Cisian Branch was a great stay.

First of all, the rooms were really nice quality with a Japanese style toilet, really nice breakfast included, a 24/7 ice cream/ tea/ coffee/ snack bar + a great sitting area to wind down, elevator, and a beautiful hotel design. It was definetely reasonably priced for the time that we got it which was a few days before the trip.

Secondly, the location was great. It's a 5-7 minute walk from the Liouhe Night Market and next door to a Poya and hotpot restaurant. The place has a lot of YouBikes, including one right in front of it. It took only 12-15 minutes to bike to Pier 2/ the Ferry Station to go to Cijin Island.

Finally, the staff was great and super understanding. My husband slept really well but for some reason, I couldn't sleep well the first night due to some electrical sound. I asked the staff about it the next night and the on duty staff helped me to check the room and helped fix the problem.I was extremely grateful considering I was exhausted that day and just wanted a smooth sleep. I slept well the next night- I wish I had asked earlier!

I didn't ride the bus from the local Kaohsiung sites to the hotel but it was definetely bus accessible. There's a bus that goes from the hotel to most of the touristy places. Would recommend to come!

The room and breakfast are nice.
I wanted to extend my stay and asked them if I could keep the same room if I book on Agoda, they make me book with them directly at the same price then changed their mind a few hours after and asked me for 700nt more, that makes no sense, I could have just booked on Agoda.
Other than that the staff is nice.

We had the best experience at Hub Hotel! The room including the bathroom was tidy and clean which came with a smart toilet! We had free breakfast and menu changes daily. It was complete from the main dish, appetizers, cereals, coffee, tea, and even hot milk tea. The salad and soup are my favorites! Unlimited ice cream, coffee, tea, and snacks were available 24/7. The staff were very accomodating and nice. Toiletries were always refilled. The blower had cold air! We were able to watch Netflix on the TV. The hotel is just a bit far from the station but can be walked. It was also near Liuhe Night Market so we were able to go there! There were so many convenience stores nearby too. When we were leaving, the staff also booked us a cab to the airport. Overall, I’d rate it 100/10! This should be a 5-star hotel. I’ll definitely book here again if I return to Kaohsiung!

Superior Double Room

Spacious enough. Free unlimited ice cream and coffee for 24 hours in their cafeteria. Which is great if you just want to chill out.

Rooms are also great value for money. They provided earplugs incase of noise at night but during our stay it is quiet.

A bit walking distance to the Cianjin station.

What could've been a good experience at the hotel was ruined by a bed bug infestation in their room.

My friends and I stayed at the hotel from October 25 - 30, 2024. We booked 2 rooms (1 room with a double bed and another room with 2 double beds). One of us who stayed in the family room (room with 2 double beds), woke up after the second night with a few itchy red marks on the arm. As it was only around 2-3 bite marks, we passed it off as mosquito bites that could've been gotten outside the hotel. After the third night, the bite marks increased to more than 20 (on both hands, arms, and legs near the  ankles). We had to visit a pharmacy to buy allergy meds (to relieve the itch) and some ointment. That day, we also reported it to the receptionist and asked to be moved rooms. They did so without any further questions except "Was it from the bed or the towels?" which may imply that they are aware if the bed bug issue in their hotel or may have received similar complaints before. We got transferred to a same room type and fortunately no additional bug bites were observed in the next days.

The hotel had good location - walking distance from restaurants, convenience stores, Liuhe night market, and train and bus stations. The staff were friendly and accommodating and the breakfast selection was decent (better spread during weekends; buns weren't served during weekdays). There was a also a 24/7 snack bar with free flowing ice cream, coffee, and biscuits. Unfortunately these good points are not enough to compensate for the inconvenience brought by the bed bugs: discomfort from the bites which continues until after the trip, additional costs from meds, poor quality of sleep (which must've been a top priority in a hotel), and effort to transfer rooms.

(Bite mark photos are taken on Nov 4)

reviews.text:
The staff were very helpful, and the location was convenient, being close to a train station.

However, there were significant issues. There was no elevator, making it difficult to carry luggage, and the stairs were very steep and a bit dangerous to go up and down.

The room was extremely small, and when the window opened, it faced the wall of the next building just a meter away, with a noisy air conditioner.

The bathroom was poorly designed, with no separation between the shower and toilet, causing the entire area to get wet after a shower. The door was moldy, and there was no fridge or hangers for clothes or towels.

A large gap under the door allowed light to come in all night, and the soundproofing was poor, making it easy to hear noise from the corridor. Overall, I would not go back.

1.Poor air quality; the room had a strange odor and was very humid.

2.Poor sound insulation; I frequently heard noises from outside the door and the adjacent rooms.

3.The bathroom layout does not separate wet and dry areas, and there was water leakage in the room where I stayed.
we go for Holiday in Kaohsiung and here near attraction like night market and we can put our luggage in the lobby to strolling around
Not good for traveler

It was very quiet when I checked in, no noise or smell.
It's a pity that the air-conditioning remote control is malfunctioning and the temperature can only display ten digits, but it does not affect the stay experience.
I think the bed and pillows are moderately soft and firm. The bathroom is also very clean.

reviews.text:
Very good value accommodations. The room was large and had little extras like milk tea powder and a book to read in Chinese.

The room smelled of cigarettes, even though it said non smoking.

But the free breakfast brought up to our room in the morning made it easier to over look something like that.

Very friendly staff. They even took a picture with us before we left!

Would stay here again.

Room too stuffy, bad in air circulation as well..found few hair strands on bed, room have some smoked smells..before i made decision to stay at this hotel was because it had mentioned parking is provided, but it turned out that we've to find our own parking, it's so inconvenience..

Welcome to a hotel like it was in Gotham City… too many thing to comment so I simplify it below in numbers.
1. Bed bugs. My son and I was bitten at a few places.
2. Hairs on bedsheets / quilts. Same like other comments. Where does all these hair comes from?
3. Non-adjustable air conditioning unit. Cold!
4. Some electrical switches are broken.
5. Hair dryer switch was broken.
6. The TV is damaged in bottom part, so we can’t watch it well.
7. Google maps states “Free Parking”. This needs to change. There is no free parking.

I stayed in room 303. Just in case the owner reads this and wants to improve.
I had a wonderful experience at the hotel. Stuffs were very helpful. The hotel is located beside the Love river.

Excellent customer service check in and check out ( late check offer with out asking )
Breakfast 5 Star 🌟 ( Western ) room super comfortable with bath tub .

reviews.text: Amazing location, just across the street from Kaohsiung Station yet still quiet and peaceful. Just minutes away from a Family mart and several good restaurants around the area. My room was extremely spacious and comfortable; bathroom was clean and well-equipped. Service was friendly, breakfast buffet was simple but tasty, and the free washing machine was a plus (dryers are paid for though). Overall, highly recommended, and I would definitely return next time I'm in Kaohsiung.

For the price, probably the best hotel rooms I’ve stayed in. Free breakfast was fresh, tasty and not too large but with plenty of both Asian and Western options. Served until 10am every day and it was included in the stay.

Washing machines are in the room next to the dining area and detergent and washing was free. The dryers were very small and costed 20NTD but even after 2-3 cycles our clothes were not completely dry. We even separated our wet laundry into two separate machines. Just something to be cautious of!

Our room itself was very clean, spacious and comfortable. The toilet, shower and bathtub were all separated which I liked. Across the street from Kaohsiung station, which made for a pretty convenient location.

The self check in and out machine was easy to use. There is no one manning the front desk from 11PM to 6AM outside of emergency but that was not an issue for us!

I stayed in Kaohsiung for 2x days, and it was the nicest hotel I've stayed at during my 2 week trip to Taiwan. The hotel is clean, the staff is friendly, overall great value in addition to feeling relatively updated compared to other places I stayed at. Below are pros and cons:

Overall I highly recommend staying here, I plan to stay here again in the future when I visit Taiwan again.

Perfect location. Very near Kaohsiung metro station.

Rooms are new and modern. Bed is very comfoetable.

They don't provide dental kit so you have to bring your own.

Overall not bad for its value, definitely would come back again.

Location is great! Right outside the main station and MRT, walking 15 mins to famous tourist night market.

They offer free laundry detergent and washing machines, just need to pay for coin dryers, very handy for travelers who’s staying longer. WiFi isn’t working well, it constantly log you out, and when you try to log in again it failed, sometimes it shows connected but can’t load the page…we ended up didn’t bother to try again.

Check in was done at the kiosk, scan your ID and click through the screen which was quite easy. Room is not big, but tidy and clean and has a small bathtub. Buffet breakfast was ok.

A suggestion, plz make sure giving proper hospitality training to your staff. The front house staff can be more friendly and more helpful. They seem to be robotic, lack of enthusiasm and no smile, also not very helpful.
